blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
In this paper, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to predict the next best move (NBM) in tasks requiring sequential reasoning and lookahead, without explicitly exploring future steps or exhaustive searching at inference. Previous work demonstrated that these models can generate complete solutions to geometric and reasoning problems. Here, we show that simple fine-tuning on visual state--NBM pairs enables a pretrained model to select actions whose value depends on consequences several steps ahead. Each move is predicted directly in image space from the current state, without an explicit symbolic representation or search procedure. Repeated NBM predictions then construct a solution one decision at a time.
  We demonstrate this capability on chess puzzles and tile-based pathfinding, and show that it extends to Connect Four, Go and billiards. In chess, the model predicts legal moves and finds the best move far more often than by recalling similar training positions, including piece sacrifices whose benefit emerges only through later tactical continuations. In pathfinding, it constructs shortest paths on uniform-cost maps and cost-optimal routes across terrain tiles with different traversal costs, choosing longer routes when they are cheaper overall. These costs are learned implicitly from examples, without numerical cost supervision. These results show that direct visual move prediction can support globally informed decisions and successful sequential problem solving.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “I see only one move ahead, but it is always the correct one.” — attributed to José Raúl Capablanca
blocks.zh: “我只看到向前迈出了一步,但这始终是正确的一步。”

blocks.en:
Visual generative models have demonstrated a surprising ability to solve
hard problems by generating their solutions as images. Beyond synthesizing
realistic appearance, visual diffusion models can produce geometric
configurations, complete puzzles, and construct paths that satisfy complex
constraints [ 7 , 22 , 8 , 5 ] .
These findings suggest that visual generation can support forms of
reasoning traditionally addressed by specialized algorithms. In this work,
we investigate whether visual diffusion models can also learn to predict
the next best move (NBM): choosing an action that advances a task toward
its solution, without searching over future states. It’s worth mentioning that our goal is not to develop a task-specific solver (e.g., a competitive chess player), but to demonstrate and analyze an intriguing capability of visual diffusion models. We use chess, pathfinding, and other tasks as testbeds to investigate and better understand this capability.

consequences several steps ahead. Generating a complete solution allows
its parts to be represented and refined together. NBM prediction instead
commits to a single action without producing the continuation that
justifies it. The challenge is therefore to capture the benefit of
lookahead through direct visual prediction, without explicitly exploring
future steps at inference.

We show that a pretrained visual diffusion model can learn to make
such decisions by fine-tuning on pairs of visual states and their
next best moves. Given the current state as an image, the model

future moves at once. The number of moves predicted is commonly

blocks.en: Our study of next best move (NBM) prediction reveals a surprising finding: predicting the move from the first denoising step is more accurate than using a fully denoised sample. At this early stage, several possible moves appear as overlapping marks in a single image. The strongest marks often reveal the correct move. We can thus read out the model’s preferred move before denoising is complete.

blocks.en:
A chess puzzle presents a board position and asks the player to find
a sequence of moves that achieves a tactical objective, such as
checkmate or a decisive material advantage. Solving it requires
choosing moves that succeed against the opponent’s best responses.
Many moves may be legal, but only a few advance toward the solution.

blocks.en:

A bishop, for example, is represented only by its visual appearance;
the model must learn from visual examples how it moves and when
moving it is useful. Fine-tuning pairs show board images and their
next best moves, providing supervision for both valid movement
patterns and effective action selection.

In this held-out puzzle, White can capture an undefended rook with Qxe3, gaining material immediately. Instead, the model predicts Qf7+, offering its queen to force the black king into the corner. held-out tile maps. The agent moves between adjacent traversable tiles,

blocks.en: Executing a horizon. How many predicted moves to execute depends on how much of the future the current state determines. In a deterministic single-agent task, they can be executed directly: this replaces H H calls with one, and when H H equals the solution length L L , the entire solution is drawn in a single image. Against an opponent, moves beyond the next depend on replies that may differ from the predicted ones, so we use a receding horizon [ 15 ] : only the first predicted move is executed, the true state is observed, and the model is called again. This recovers the closed loop of Eq. 1 , but each decision now comes with the continuation the model expects to follow from it. One formulation thus covers single decisions ( H = 1 H=1 ), decisions with an explicit continuation (receding horizon) and complete solutions ( H = L H=L ); Sec. 4 compares them.

blocks.en: Setup. Chess positions are drawn from the Lichess puzzle database and split by game to prevent overlap between training and evaluation. Our main models are trained on up to three million puzzles and evaluated on 10,000 held-out positions (Appendix A.1 ). The image model predicts the next move of each puzzle solution, while the video model predicts up to eight plies, including the opponent’s replies. The remaining tasks are generated with exact solvers or engines, used only to construct training targets and score predictions (Appendix A ). Unless stated otherwise, we use 20 20 Euler steps for the image model and 30 30 UniPC steps for the video model, and invalid actions count as failures. We report next-best-move accuracy for chess and the fraction of optimal routes for pathfinding.

blocks.en: Is the model relying on the right pieces? Figure 5 shows the same effect on a single held-out puzzle (rated 1932). On the original board, our model plays the rook sacrifice Rxh6+, which forces mate in three. Adding a white bishop on c3 leaves the position almost unchanged visually, yet it changes the best move: the bishop now guards h8, so Qh8# mates in one, and the model switches to exactly this move. To see what each decision rests on, we remove one piece at a time and measure how much the model’s confidence in its move drops. On the original board, the sacrifice depends on the pieces that build the later mating net, namely the queen that delivers the final checks and the bishop and pawn that cover the king’s escape squares. With the added bishop, the decision depends most on the two pieces that make the new mate work: the bishop guarding h8 and Black’s own pawn on g6, which blocks the king’s only escape. Removing either of them indeed makes Qh8 no longer mate. The model thus separates two boards that differ in a single piece as the position requires, and Table 1 shows that this holds over thousands of such changes.

blocks.en: Implicit policy. A diffusion model can also score outputs it did not sample, through its denoising error, as in diffusion classifiers [ 12 , 3 ] . For this analysis only, we enumerate the legal moves, draw each into the output image, measure how well the model denoises it under shared noise, and turn the errors into a policy with a softmax. Its most likely move is more often correct than any sampled readout of the same model, and it ranks the remaining moves in agreement with Stockfish (Appendix D.2 ). In Figure 4 , every knight move gives check, yet most of the policy goes to Nh6+, the only one that wins.

blocks.en: One step reads the decision. Training gives the model a distribution π ⁡ ( m ∣ c ) \pi(m\mid c) over the moves m m of a board c c , and the number of denoising steps only decides how this distribution is read out. The reason lies in the training objective: the best prediction of the clean output from a noisy one is the mean of all clean outputs that could have produced it, and at full noise, where the input carries no information about the move, this mean is the average of the move images I m I_{m} weighted by their probabilities, x ^ 0 = 𝔼 ⁡ [ x 0 ∣ c ] = ∑ m π ⁡ ( m ∣ c ) ​ I m (full noise) \hat{x}_{0}\;=\;\mathbb{E}[\,x_{0}\mid c\,]\;=\;\textstyle\sum_{m}\pi(m\mid c)\,I_{m}\qquad\text{(full noise)} (5) (Tweedie’s formula [ 4 ] ; Proof in Appendix D.1 ). A single step therefore returns the whole distribution at once, and its strongest marks pick out the most likely move. This is why one step is the more accurate readout in every task that asks for a single decision (Figure 6 , Table 1 ), and it also sets its limit: because the average hardly depends on the noise, repeated one-step outputs agree, and eight of them contain the answer for only 69.2% of chess puzzles. Full sampling instead follows each noise draw to a single move, chosen in proportion to its probability. One sample is right less often, but eight of them contain the answer for 85.4%. One step is thus the better answer and sampling the better source of candidates, and the gap between the two is headroom that no readout without the answer yet exploits. Averaging also explains why routes need full sampling: the average of several routes is not itself a route. In every task the decision is fixed within the first steps of denoising (Appendix D.3 ), as observed for video models solving mazes [ 16 ] ; the remaining steps refine one candidate rather than search among several (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: Going beyond chess. The same formulation applies without modification to tasks with substantially different action spaces (Table 2 ). What these tasks share is what the formulation needs: what the player observes can be shown in one image, and the action can be expressed as an edit of that image, for instance by marking the piece to move and its destination, the point to play, or the direction and strength of a shot. Within this class, the model must infer the properties of each task that are never stated. In pathfinding it is the cost of terrain: with costs hidden, the closed-loop image model finds the cheapest route on 87.5 87.5 % of maps, against 59.2 59.2 % for breadth-first search, which ignores terrain, while on uniform maps the video model, which plans several moves per clip, generalises better to longer paths. In Connect Four it is gravity: the disc lands in the correct row in all but one of 2,000 test positions for the image model and all but eight for the video model. In Go it is the rules of play: stones land on a legal point 99.8 99.8 % of the time, and the model matches KataGo’s move on 31.1 31.1 % of positions, against 1.7 1.7 % for copying the nearest training position. In billiards it is the physics of the table: the video model pots the ball on 47.9 47.9 % of held-out layouts, against 19.0 19.0 % for reusing the nearest training shot (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 超越了棋局. 同一提法适用于动作空间大相径庭的任务(表2)。 这些任务共享的是配方需要的东西:玩家观察到的东西可以在一个图像中显示,动作可以表现为该图像的编辑,例如通过标记要移动的棋子及其去向,玩出点,或者射击的方向和强度. 在这一类中,模型必须推断每个任务从未说明的属性. 在寻找路径时,它是地形的成本:随着成本的隐藏,闭路图像模型在87.5 87.5%的地图上找到最便宜的路线,而59.2 59.2%的宽度第一搜索则忽略了地形,而在统一的地图上,视频模型计划了每次剪辑数个动作,概括到更长的路径更好. 在"连接四"中,是地心引力:光碟落在正确的一行中,除了图像模型的2000个测试位置之一之外,所有图像模型的测试位置除了8个之外。 Go是游戏规则:石块在99.8 99.8%的时间内落地,模型与KataGo的31.1%的职位相匹配,而抄袭最近的训练职位的比例为1.7.7%。 在台球中,这是表的物理:视频模型将球按47.9 47.9%的被搁置布局来投出,而19.0 19.0%的重用最近的训练镜头(附录A.).

blocks.en: Learning from the continuation. Drawing the future also helps the model decide the present. A video model trained to draw the whole solution line, replies included, predicts the next move more accurately than the same model trained on the first move alone, although only the first move is scored (24.6% against 21.4% in chess, with the same 400,000 puzzles and training budget), and the same holds on terrain for both models. Controlled experiments on a purpose-built pathfinding task show why (Appendix K ): when the first move is decided by a single wall k k cells down one of two otherwise identical corridors, with equal training a model only trained on the first move ignores the wall beyond two cells, while one trained to draw the route uses it up to twelve cells away; the gain comes from training rather than from reading the drawn continuation at inference. Whether the drawn moves should also be played depends on the task. In deterministic tasks such as shortest paths, executing a whole clip is as accurate as predicting again after each move, with far fewer model calls. Against an opponent, a new prediction on the observed board is better than following the drawn continuation (52.5% against 41.2% for the next move on identical boards). Predicting the future can make each decision better, and against an opponent, each decision is best made on the board as it actually is.
blocks.zh: 学从续行. 绘制未来也有助于模型决定现在。 接受过绘制整个解决方案线的培训的视频模型,包括答复,预测下一个动作比第一次动作训练的同一模型更准确,尽管只有第一次动作得分(在棋局中24.6%对21.4%,同样拥有40万个谜题和训练预算),两种模型的地势也相同. 对目的所构建的路径查找任务的受控实验显示了为什么(附录K):当第一次移动由一面墙kk细胞在两个原本相同的通道下下行决定时,平等训练一个只经过第一次移动训练的模型忽略了墙外两个细胞,而一个经过训练的绘制路径使用到12个细胞外去;收益来自训练而不是在推论中读取所绘制的续作. 是否还应当播放所绘制的动作取决于任务. 在最短路径等决定性任务中,执行一整段截图与每次移动后再次预测一样准确,模型调用要少得多. 针对对手,观察板上的新预测胜于跟踪抽取的续作(52.5%对41.2%对相同板上的下个动作). 预测未来可以使每个决定更好,而针对一个对手,每个决定最好像实际一样在董事会上作出.

blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Having presented our formulation and results, we now place them in
the context of visual problem solving, sequential generation, and
learned decision-making. Our focus is on learning task rules and
action preferences from visual examples, and using this knowledge
to select the next best move (NBM).
blocks.zh:
在提出了我们的提法和结果之后,我们现在把它们放在
视觉问题解决的背景,顺序生成,以及
学习决策。 我们的重点是学习任务规则和
来自视觉实例的动作偏好,并利用这种知识
来选择下一个最佳动作(NBM)。

blocks.en: Goren et al. [ 7 ] show that visual diffusion models can be used to generate complete solutions to geometric problems in pixel space, including the inscribed square, Steiner tree, and maximum-area polygon. We extend visual solution generation to sequential decisions: in chess and pathfinding, successive predicted actions construct solutions, even when an action’s value depends on later consequences.
blocks.zh: Goren等 (英语). [7] 显示可使用视觉扩散模型来生成像素空间中几何问题的完整解决方案,包括所刻入的正方形,斯泰纳树和最大区域多边形. 我们把视觉解决方案的生成扩展到顺序决定:在棋局和路径调查中,连续预测的行动构建解决方案,即使一个行动的价值取决于后来的后果。

blocks.en:
DiffThinker [ 8 ] fine-tunes a pretrained image-editing
model to generate complete visual solutions to tasks including mazes,
TSP, Sudoku, and jigsaws. Video models have also shown signs of reasoning by generating maze trajectories, both zero-shot [ 23 ] and after supervised fine-tuning [ 26 ] . These works establish visual generation as a means of producing complete solutions or their unfolding trajectories. Our single-move model makes a different
commitment: it selects an action without generating its future continuation. Our horizon model connects these formulations by generating short continuations, allowing us to compare decisions made with and without an explicit visual trajectory.
blocks.zh:
diffThinker [8] 微调预训图像编辑
模型生成完整的视觉解决方案 任务包括迷宫,
TSP, Sudoku, 还有相机。 视频模型也通过生成迷宫轨迹表现出推理的征兆,既为零发[23],也经过被监督的微调[26]. 这些作品将视觉生成设定为生成完整解决方案或正在发展出轨迹的手段. 我们的单行走模式就不一样了
承诺:它选择一项行动而不产生未来的延续。 我们的地平线模型通过产生短长的续作来连接这些提法,使我们能够将所作决定与没有明确的视觉轨迹进行比较。

blocks.en:
Wewer et al. [ 22 ] are closely related where they show that sequential generation can improve reasoning in denoising models. Their Spatial Reasoning Models use uncertainty to order the generation of spatial variables in visual Sudoku and other constraint tasks. Their approach selects which unknown part of a solution to resolve next, prioritizing
variables that can be predicted with greater confidence. Our experiments

outcome. The sacrifice in chess and the longer but cheaper terrain
route illustrate choices that cannot be judged by immediate gains
alone.

blocks.en:
Learning strong actions without inference-time search has also been
studied in chess using symbolic representations. Ruoss et
al. [ 18 ] train on engine-annotated positions to reach grandmaster-level play without inference-time search. DiffuSearch [ 27 ] uses discrete diffusion to predict future states and actions alongside the next move, using the generated continuation as a form of implicit search. These methods use chess-specific encodings and orders of magnitude more engine-labelled positions. We ask whether a general visual generator can learn valid and effective actions from pixels across tasks ranging from chess to billiards. Unlike a constrained chess output vocabulary, our pixel readout must learn legal and effective movements from examples alone. Our horizon variant further connects our approach to DiffuSearch by expressing predicted actions and future states visually.

Our horizon-based execution also relates to diffusion models for
planning and control. Diffuser [ 11 ] generates
trajectories through denoising using receding-horizon planning, while
Diffusion Policy [ 2 ] predicts action sequences
and executes part of each sequence before predicting again. Our
horizon model follows the same execution principle: execute the
first predicted action, observe the resulting state, and predict
again. Here, states and action markings share a visual representation,
and actions are decoded from generated pixels. In adversarial tasks,
the generated continuation also includes predicted opponent replies.
This connection places our comparison of single-move and horizon-based
prediction within the broader study of learning to act through
generative models.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this work, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to decide what to do next by learning to draw the next move. This simple formulation supports a surprisingly wide range of decisions: sacrificing a rook for a payoff several moves later, taking a longer route to avoid costly terrain, or selecting a shot in billiards. In sequential tasks, the model builds a solution one decision at a time, without explicitly searching through future continuations.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们显示视觉传播模型可以通过学习绘制下一步动作来学习决定下一步要做什么. 这种简单的表述支持出人意料的一连串决定:在数个之后牺牲一头牛来换取回报,走一条更长的路来避开昂贵的地形,或者选择台球射击. 在相继的任务中,模型一次构建一个解决方案,而不明确搜索未来的续作.

blocks.en: A natural question is why we should generate a move rather than classify it. In chess, a classifier with an output designed to score pairs of board squares can outperform our model. The advantage of generation is that the same output representation works across tasks: the model draws a chess move, a route, or a billiard shot directly on the image. This goes beyond reusing an architecture. When we train a single model on Connect Four and pathfinding together, with the same prompt for both, it matches the single-task model on Connect Four and stays within a few points of it on pathfinding. The appendix reports these comparisons in detail.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,我们为什么应该提出一个行动,而不是将其分类。 在国际象棋中,一个具有一对棋盘平方的分数输出的分级器可以超越我们的模型. 生成的优点是,相同的出品表现可以跨出任务:模型绘制出一棋动作,一行路线,或者直接从图像上拍摄出一款台球. 这不仅仅是重用一个建筑。 当我们在"连接四"和"路径调查"上一起训练出一个单一的模型,同时对两者进行相同的提示,它与"连接四"上的单任务模型相匹配,并在路径调查上停留在它的几个点之内. 附录详细报告了这些比较。

blocks.en: The most intriguing finding is that the first denoising step can be more useful for choosing a move than a fully denoised sample. It shows several possible moves as overlapping marks. In our experiments, reading the strongest marks gives a more accurate single decision than drawing one fully denoised sample, without any additional training. Full denoising remains useful when we want diverse candidates. For a model that learns to act by drawing, the first sketch can already be the better guide to what to do next.
blocks.zh: 最有意思的发现是,第一个去名步骤比一个完全去名化的样本更有助于选择一个动作. 它显示若干可能的动作作为重叠标记. 在我们的实验中,读取最强的分数,比绘制一个完全无名的样本更准确的单一决定,而无需任何额外的训练. 当我们需要不同的候选人时,完全发号施令仍然是有用的。 对于一个学习用绘画来行动的模式来说,第一个草图已经可以更好地指导下一步要做什么.

blocks.en: Appendix A Tasks and data
blocks.zh: 附录A 任务和数据

blocks.en: Each task presents a rendered state and asks the model to draw an action. The video model also draws subsequent actions and states. Prompts never state the rules, costs, or physics. Except for chess and Go, the prompt is simply “Continue.” An exact solver or strong engine supplies the labels used to build the data and score predictions. Below, we specify each task, its rendering, data and splits, and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都呈现成型状态,要求模型绘制出行动. 视频模型也引来后续的行动和状态. 提示从不说明规则、成本或物理 除了围棋和去, 一个精确的解析器或强大的引擎提供用于构建数据和分数预测的标签. 下面,我们具体说明每一项任务、其渲染、数据和分割以及评价。

blocks.en: A.1 Chess
blocks.zh: A.1 国际象棋

blocks.en: Problem. Positions come from the Lichess puzzle database. Each puzzle starts after the opponent’s last move and has an engine-verified solution line in which only the first move of the side to move is forced to be unique. The target is that first move.
blocks.zh: 有问题 位置来自 Liches 拼图数据库 。 每个谜题从对手的上个动作后开始,并有一条引擎验证的解决方案线,其中只有一方移动的第一个动作被迫是独一无二的. 目标是第一个动作。

blocks.en: Rendering. Boards are drawn from White’s side at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 pixels, without coordinates. The model marks a move by tinting the origin square blue and the destination square red. The image model’s prompt is “ White to move. Highlight the best move: the origin square in blue and the destination square in red. ” (Black analogously). The video model additionally draws green dots on the legal destination squares of the moving piece and then shows the board after the move, as described in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 发作. 从怀特一侧取出256×256×256}256像素,没有坐标。 该模型通过将起源地正方形蓝色和目的地正方形红色用锡来标记一个动作. 图像模型的提示是 " 白色可以移动。 突出显示最佳动作:由蓝色的起源广场和红色的目的地广场。” (黑色类似地)。 如附录B所描述的那样,视频模型在移动作品的合法目的地平方上还另外绘制了绿色点,然后在移动后显示棋盘.

blocks.en: Data and splits. Puzzles are assigned to splits by a hash of the game they come from, so all puzzles of one game share a split. Any puzzle whose start position appears in validation or test (same pieces, side to move, castling and en passant rights) is removed from training, which also excludes transpositions. Validation and test keep only well-established puzzles (rating deviation at most 90 and at least 200 plays) and are stratified over eight rating bands, from below 1000 to above 2500. This gives 5,808,734 training, 2,000 validation and 10,000 test puzzles. The models of Tab. 1 train on the first three million training puzzles. The variants and analyses in this supplement use the first million unless stated otherwise. For the video model, each puzzle becomes a line of up to eight solution plies (mean 3.6).
blocks.zh: 数据与分出. 谜题被分配到由所出游戏的散列分出,因此一个游戏的所有谜题都共享分出. 任何在验证或测试中出现起始位置的谜题(相同的棋子、移动的侧面、阉割和通过权)都被从培训中删除,这也排除了转接位置。 验证和测试只保留了已确立的谜题(评分偏差最多为90个,至少为200个剧作)并分级分出8个分级分级,从1000分以下到2500分以上. 这给了5,808,734个训练,2000个验证和10,000个测试谜题. 塔布一号列车在前三百万个训练谜题上的模型. 除另有说明外,本补编中的变体和分析使用第一百万个。 对于视频模型来说,每个谜题会变成一行可达8个解决方案活页(mean 3.6).

blocks.en: Engine labels. For the implicit-policy analysis and for contrastive guidance we score every legal move with Stockfish 19 (all moves at depth 12, at most 4M nodes per position, one thread). Scores are converted to a win probability for the side to move with the Lichess formula, and forced mates rank above every centipawn score. The engine’s best move equals the puzzle answer on 99.8% of test positions.
blocks.zh: 发动机标签 为了隐含的政策分析和对比性指导,我们得分了与"鱼鱼"19的每一个合法动作(所有动作在深度12,每个位置最多为4M节点,一线). 分数被转换为一方使用利切斯公式移动的取胜概率,而被强迫的相配者排在每分分数上方. 引擎的最佳动作等于99.8%的测试位置的谜题解答.

blocks.en: Metrics and baselines. A prediction is correct when the move read from the generated image ( Appendix C ) equals the puzzle answer. Promotion pieces are ignored. We report two subsets: sacrifices (1,001 test puzzles tagged as such by Lichess) and far from training , the test puzzles whose nearest training position differs on 13 to 16 of the 64 squares (1,757 puzzles against the three million training puzzles, 2,403 against the first million). Retrieval baselines and their construction are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 计量和基线。 当从生成的图像(附录C)读取的动作等于谜题答案时,预测是正确的. 宣传片被忽略. 我们报告两个子集:牺牲(1,001个被Liches标记为这样的测试谜题)和远离训练的测试谜题,它们最近的训练位置在64个平方中的13到16个(1,757个谜题与300万个训练谜题相比,2,403个谜题与第100万个谜题相比). 检索基线及其构造载于附录E。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Billiards decisions and outcomes. Each column shows a held-out layout for one shot type: direct, bank, kick, or combination. Top: The video model’s unaltered output marks the shot with an aim line from the cue ball, a cue stick behind it, and a power bar whose fill indicates shot strength. Bottom: The corresponding simulator rollout. The dashed line traces the cue ball, and the ring marks the pocket that receives the red ball. The bank, kick, and combination layouts are hard, where no direct pot exists.
blocks.zh: 图7:比利牛斯决定和成果。 每列显示一个射击类型的被搁置布局:直接,银行,踢出或组合. 顶: 视频模型的未变输出标记了镜头, 镜头从提示球上射出一线, 底部 : 相应的模拟器推出. 被折断的一行会跟随入球,而环会标出接收红球的口袋. 银行,踢出,和组合布局都很困难,那里没有直接的锅.

blocks.en: A.2 Shortest paths and terrain
blocks.zh: A.2 道路和地形最短

blocks.en: Problem. An agent on an N × N N{\times}N grid ( N ≤ 12 N\leq 12 ) must reach a goal. In the uniform variant every step costs the same and the target is a shortest path. In the terrain variant, cells are floor, mud or sand, entering them costs 1, 2 or 4, and the target is a cheapest path. Walls cannot be entered. The costs are never shown and must be inferred from examples.
blocks.zh: 有问题 N × N N\ times}N网格(N 12 N\leq 12)上的代理人必须达到目标. 在统一变体中,每一步成本相同,目标是最短的路径. 在地形变体中,细胞为地表,泥地或沙地,进入它们的成本为1,2或4,而目标是最便宜的路径. 无法输入墙壁 。 费用从未显示,必须从实例中推断。

blocks.en: Rendering. Maps are drawn at 384 × 384 384{\times}384 pixels with 32-pixel cells, so a cell is exactly one video-model token and 2 × 2 2{\times}2 image-model tokens. The agent is a blue disc, the goal a red ring, and visited cells are green. Mud has stripes and sand has dots, so the two can be told apart without colour alone. A rule-free decoder reads every cell by matching its centre, ring and corner colours to the known palette.
blocks.zh: 发作. 地图被绘制为384×384384\times}384像素有32-像素的细胞,所以一个细胞完全是一个视频-模型活符和2×2\times}2个图像-模型活符. 代理人为蓝盘,入球为红环,被访问的细胞为绿色. 泥有花纹而沙有花点,因此两者可以单独分辨出颜色. 一个无规则解码器通过将其中心,环和角等颜色与已知调色板相匹配来读取每个单元格.

blocks.en: Formats. The image model operates in a closed loop: it marks the next cell with a red disc, the move is applied, and the resulting state becomes the next input. The video model generates segments of up to eight moves, each with a decision frame and the resulting state. Longer routes chain these segments. The receding-horizon variant executes only the first decision from each segment ( Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 形式。 图像模型在闭环中运行:用红盘来标记下个单元格,动作被应用,所形成的状态会成为下个输入. 视频模型产生可达8个动作的片段,每个片段都有决策框和所产生状态. 更长的路程会将这些路段连在一起. 折返范围变式只执行每个部分的第一个决定(附录C)。

blocks.en: Data. Maps come from three families: random blocks (15 to 32% wall density), walls with one or two gaps, and rooms made by recursive division. Terrain maps cover 25 to 45% of free cells with mud or sand. Targets are computed by breadth-first search (Dijkstra for terrain), breaking ties by fewest turns, and evaluation accepts any optimal path. Each variant has 200,000 training maps and 600 validation maps. The uniform variant has 1,000 in-distribution test maps and three out-of-distribution tests of 500 maps each: larger maps ( N N = 11 or 12), longer paths (21 to 32 steps) and mazes, a family never seen in training. The terrain variant has 1,000 test maps and a probe set of 500 maps on which every cheapest path either crosses a band of costly terrain (250 maps) or goes around it (250 maps). No evaluation map appears in training, and the evaluation sets are pairwise disjoint.
blocks.zh: 数据。 地图出自三个家族:随机区块(占墙体密度的15%至32%),有一两个缺口的墙壁,由递归分出的房间. 地平图覆盖了25-45%有泥或沙的自由细胞. 目标通过广度第一搜索(Dijkstra for Terriface)计算,通过最少的转弯断开联系,评价接受任何最佳路径. 每个变体有20万个训练地图和600个验证地图. 统一变体有1000个分流测试地图和3个分流测试,每个分出500个地图:更大的地图(N N = 11或12),更长的路径(21至32步)和迷宫,一个在训练中从未见过的家庭. 地形变体有1000个测试地图和由500个地图组成的探测器集,每条最便宜的路径要么跨越一带昂贵的地形(250个地图),要么绕到四周(250个地图). 培训中没有显示评价图,评价集是双向的。

blocks.en: Metrics and baselines. A route is valid if it is connected, avoids walls and revisits, and changes nothing off the path. It is optimal if it is valid and has the optimal length (terrain: the optimal cost). On the probe set, a route is correct if it is valid and crosses the band exactly when the cheapest paths do. The terrain-blind baseline follows a shortest path in steps. It is cost-optimal on 59.2% of terrain test maps and, by construction of the probe set, correct on half of the probe maps. The pretrained models without fine-tuning never produce a valid route. On the maze test, the image and video models are optimal on 78.4 and 84.4% of maps.
blocks.zh: 计量和基线。 一条路线如果连接起来,避免墙壁并再行回想,并且不会改变任何偏离路径的路由,则是有效的. 如果它有效并且有最佳长度(地铁:最优成本),那么它是最佳的. 在探测器设定上,如果一个路径是有效的,并且恰好在最便宜的路径完成的时候跨越了波段,那么这个路径是正确的. 地形盲基线沿最短的路走步. 在59.2%的地表测试地图上,它是成本-最佳的,通过建造探测器组,在探测器图上半数正确。 未经微调预先训练的型号,从未产生出有效的路线. 在迷宫测试中,图像和视频模型在78.4%和84.4%的地图上是最佳的.

blocks.en: A.3 Connect Four
blocks.zh: A.3. 连接四

blocks.en: Problem. Standard 7 × 6 7{\times}6 Connect Four: the model chooses a column for the side to move. That a disc falls to the lowest free row is never stated.
blocks.zh: 有问题 标准7×6 7{\times}6 Connect Four:模型选择一栏供侧移动. 一张圆盘落到最低自由行 从来没有说过

blocks.en: Rendering. Boards are 256 × 256 256{\times}256 pixels with 32-pixel cells. Red moves first and blue second, and a disc in the top margin shows whose turn it is. A move is drawn as the mover’s disc in its landing cell, tinted green.
blocks.zh: 发作. 板为256×256 256\times}256像素有32-像素细胞. 红色第一和蓝色第二,顶边的一盘显示它是谁的转弯. 动画是移动者在着陆室的圆盘,

blocks.en: Data. Positions come from self-play games in which each player plays a random legal move with a probability drawn from { 0 , 0.05 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.35 , 0.5 } \{0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.35,0.5\} and otherwise a best or value-preserving move. We keep only critical positions, in which not every column has the same game-theoretic value. Labels come from Pascal Pons’ exact solver. The label is a best column, and evaluation accepts any best column. There are 200,000 training, 1,000 validation and 2,000 test positions, plus a hard test set of 1,000 positions with neither an immediate win nor an immediate threat. Positions are deduplicated up to mirror symmetry within and across splits, and each evaluation set takes at most one position per game.
blocks.zh: 数据。 位置取自自自玩游戏,每名玩家在游戏中玩出随机合法动作,概率取自{0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.35,0.5}}}}##0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.35,0.5}否则是最佳或保值动作. 我们只保留关键位置,其中并非每个栏目都有相同的游戏理论价值. 标签来自Pascal Pons的精确解析器。 标签为最佳栏目,评价接受任何最佳栏目. 训练有20万人次,验证有1000人次,测试有2000人次,外加有1000人次的硬测试组合,既无即时取胜,也无即时威胁. 位置被折叠到镜像对称的分块内部和相片之间,每套评价最多每个游戏一个位置.

blocks.en: Metrics and baselines. Legal, correct landing row : the marked column is not full and the disc is drawn in the row where it would land. Keeps the win : on the hard test set, the chosen move preserves the game-theoretic value of the position, so a won position stays won and a drawn one stays drawn. Of the 1,000 hard positions, 936 are won. The one-move heuristic wins immediately if it can, otherwise blocks the opponent’s immediate win, otherwise plays the most central legal column.
blocks.zh: 计量和基线。 合法,正确的起落行:标记的一栏不全,并画出一行的圆盘来降落. 保持取胜 : 在硬测试集上,所选动作保留了位置的游戏-理论值,因此一个取胜的位置保留了取胜,一个取出的位置保留了取出. 在1000个硬立场中,有936个获得胜利. 一动一动的热力主义如果能够立即取胜,否则会阻碍对手的即时取胜,否则将扮演最核心的法律一栏.

blocks.en: A.4 Go
blocks.zh: A.4. 开始

blocks.en: Problem. Full 19 × 19 19{\times}19 Go. The model marks the move KataGo prefers.
blocks.zh: 问题 完全19×19 19克时 19克时 19克出局 模型标志着卡塔戈更喜欢的动作

blocks.en: Data and labels. We take games between strong amateurs (7 dan, or both players at least 6 dan) from the public KGS archive, keeping even games of at least 80 moves played up to 2015 without bots. Positions are sampled from the middle of each game. Each position is searched by KataGo (network b11c768 , 400 visits, Chinese rules, komi 7.5), and the label is the move with the most visits. Positions whose outcome is already clear are filtered out. The smaller training set has 100,000 positions from 44,191 games, and the larger one has 1,000,000 positions from 91,253 games. Both share 1,000 validation and 2,000 test positions, and no game or board position is shared between splits.
blocks.zh: 数据与标签. 我们从公开的KGS档案中取取强业余选手(7 dan,或双方玩家至少6 dan)之间的游戏,将至少80个动作的游戏保留到2015年,没有bots. 位置从每场游戏的中间取出样本. 每个位置由KataGo搜索(network b11c768,400 访问,中国规则,komi 7.5),标签是最多访问的动作. 结果已经明确的位置将被过滤出。 更小的训练集拥有从44,191场比赛起的10万个位置,更大的一个拥有从91,253场比赛起的1,000,000个位置. 两者共享1000个验证和2000个测试位置,并且没有在拆分之间共享游戏或棋盘位置.

blocks.en: Rendering and prompt. Boards are 384 × 384 384{\times}384 pixels, and the move is a red disc on the chosen point. The prompt is “ Black to play. Mark the best move with a red dot. ” (White analogously).
blocks.zh: 发相并出. 相板为384×384384×times}384像素,移动是所选点上的一个红盘. 提示是“黑人可以玩。 以红点标出最佳动作。 (白色类似地)。

blocks.en: Metrics and baselines. A prediction is correct when the decoded point equals KataGo’s move. With about 296 legal points per position, a random legal move is correct 0.35% of the time in expectation. The single random draw reported in Tab. 2 is correct on 15 of the 2,000 positions (0.7%). Copying the move of the nearest training position is correct 1.7% of the time. For reference, KataGo’s raw policy network alone (no search) matches its own searched move 74.0% of the time, and the move played in the game matches 39.5%.
blocks.zh: 计量和基线。 当解码点等于 KataGo 的动作时, 预测是正确的 。 每个职位约有296个法律分,随机合法移动正确率为预期时间的0.35%. Tab 中报告的单随机图 。 在2 000个职位中,有15个职位(0.7%)是正确的。 复制最近训练职位的移动时间为1.7%。 作为参考,KataGo的原始政策网络(没有搜索)与自己搜索的移动(74.0%)匹配,游戏中所玩的移动匹配39.5%.

blocks.en: A.5 Billiards
blocks.zh: A.5 台球

blocks.en: Problem. A table holds the cue ball, a red target ball and up to four other balls. The model chooses a shot, a cue direction and a power, and succeeds if the red ball is potted and the cue ball is not.
blocks.zh: 有问题 一张桌子握住一分球,一分红靶球和最多四分球. 该型号选择出一出出出一出出一出出一出出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出一出

blocks.en: Simulator and solver. Shots are simulated by a deterministic 2D simulator without spin: rolling friction, elastic ball collisions (restitution 0.95), cushions (restitution 0.8) and six pockets. For each layout we simulate 12,960 shots (every 0.25 ∘ 0.25^{\circ} and nine powers) and take as label the centre of the widest successful range of angles that is robust to small changes in power. Shots include direct pots, banks, kicks, kisses and combinations.
blocks.zh: 模拟并解. 射击由定型2D模拟器模拟而无自旋:滚动摩擦,弹性球相撞(还原0.95),平垫(还原0.8)和6个口袋. 每个布局,我们模拟12 960发子弹(每发0.25发,每发0.25发,每发9发),并将最广泛的成功角度作为中心标记,这些角度对权力的微小变化是强有力的。 射击包括直取锅,银行,踢,接吻和组合.

blocks.en: Rendering. Tables are 512 × 288 512{\times}288 pixels. A shot is drawn as a cyan aiming line from the cue ball to where its centre would first meet a cushion, drawn under the balls, together with a magenta cue stick behind the cue ball and a power bar under the table. A rule-free decoder reads the angle from the line and stick and the power from the filled part of the bar. On clean renders its angle error has a median of 0.003 ∘ 0.003^{\circ} . In the video model’s clip, the decision frame is followed by the simulated motion of the balls.
blocks.zh: 发作. 表格为512×288 512\times}288像素. 一个镜头被划成青色瞄准线,从球杆球到球中心首先会碰到一个垫子,从球杆下被划出,同时在球杆球后有红外线球杆和桌下有电源棒. 一个无规则的解码器从线和棒上读出角度,从被填充的部分读出力量. 在清理时,其角度误差的中位数为0.003 0.003 Circ}。 在视频模型的剪辑中,决定框后面是球的模拟运动.

blocks.en: Data and metrics. There are 200,000 training, 1,000 validation and 2,000 test layouts, and a mirrored copy of every test layout. No layout is shared between splits up to the table’s symmetries. A shot counts as potted if the decoded shot succeeds in the simulator. The nearest-shot baseline finds the training layout whose cue and red balls are closest (including mirrored layouts) and reuses its shot. It pots 19.0% of test layouts, and a random shot 0.7%. On the mirrored layouts the one-step image and video models pot 28.2 and 49.1%, against 28.0 and 47.9% on the originals.
blocks.zh: 数据和衡量标准。 有20万人次的训练,1000个验证和2000个测试布局,每个测试布局都有一张镜像拷贝. 平分到表的对称之间不共享布局 。 如果被解码的镜头在模拟器中成功,则一发即为被打倒. 距离最近的射入基线发现射入点和红球最接近的训练布局(包括镜面布局)并再用其射入点. 抽取了19.0%的测试布局,随机抽取了0.7%. 在倒影布局上,单步图像和视频模型的锅口为28.2%和49.1%,而原版为28.0%和47.9%.

blocks.en: A.6 N-queens
blocks.zh: A.6 N-quens (韩语)

blocks.en: Problem and rendering. On a partly filled N N -queens board, the model places the next queen so that the board can still be completed with no two queens sharing a row, column or diagonal. Boards with N ≤ 12 N\leq 12 are drawn on a fixed 12 × 12 12{\times}12 grid. Qwen-Image-2.1, fine-tuned with rank-64 LoRA, receives the prompt “Continue.” and marks the next queen in red. The action is read from the strongest red mark, without a minimum-strength threshold.
blocks.zh: 问题和渲染 在被部分填充的N-queens板上,模型将下个后座放入后座,使后座板仍然可以完成,没有两个后座共用一行,一列或对角. 12 N\lEq 12的董事会 是在固定的 12x 12 时 12 格。 Quen-Image-2.1, 与64等分的LORA进行了微调,获得了即时"Contine"并用红色标记下一位王后. 动作从最强的红色标记来读取,没有最小的强度阈值.

blocks.en: Data and evaluation. We train on 200,000 boards for 24k steps, using sizes N = 8 , 9 , 10 N=8,9,10 . Whole solution families related by rotation or reflection are held out from training for validation and test: 4 of 12 families at N = 8 N=8 , 16 of 46 at N = 9 N=9 , and 30 of 92 at N = 10 N=10 . Sizes 11 and 12 are never seen in training. No test board or any of its rotations or reflections occurs in training. Exact enumeration supplies the labels: any placement that still permits a complete solution is correct. We select one sampling step on validation.
blocks.zh: 数据和评价。 我们用20万块板来训练24克台阶,使用尺寸为N=8,9,10N=8,9,10. 与轮回或反射有关的整个溶液家庭不经过认证和测试培训:12个家庭中有4个在N=8 N=8,46个家庭中有16个在N=9 N=9,92个家庭中有30个在N=10 N=10。 11和12的尺寸在训练中从未见过. 在训练中,没有试验会或其任何旋转或反射。 准确的点数提供了标签:任何仍然允许一个完整解决方案的位置是正确的. 我们在验证时选择一个取样步骤。

blocks.en: Results. On held-out solution families, the model trained on the first move only makes a completable move on 85.2% of boards and a legal placement on 99.4%. A random non-attacked cell is completable on 71.2% and copying a move from the nearest training board on 62.3%. The copier falls from 96.8% on training families to 62.3% on held-out families, while the model’s advantage over the random non-attacked choice remains similar (+15.5 and +14.0 points). On the never-trained sizes 11 and 12, the model reaches 79.2% against 72.6% for that random baseline, with 97.0% legal placements. On hard boards, it reaches 62.0% against 49.1%. At 20 sampling steps, held-out-family accuracy is 78.8%, below the validation-selected one-step result. The controlled horizon test is in Appendix K .
blocks.zh: 结果。 关于被搁置的解决方案家庭,在第一次搬迁时接受过培训的模型仅对85.2%的董事会和99.4%的合法安置进行了可完成的搬迁。 一个随机无攻击的细胞在71.2%上可被收缩,在62.3%上可抄取离最近的训练板的动作. 复印机从培训家庭的96.8%下降到被搁置家庭的62.3%,而模型相对于随机无攻击选择的优势(+15.5和+14.0分)依然相仿. 在从未受过训练的11和12号机型上,该型号为79.2%,而随机基线为72.6%,合法投放率为97.0%。 在硬板上,这一比例为62.0%,而49.1%。 在20个抽样步骤中,坚持家庭外的准确度为78.8%,低于验证后选择的一步结果。 控制地平线测试载于附录K。

blocks.en: Appendix B Models and training
blocks.zh: 附录B 模式和培训

blocks.en: Image model. We fine-tune Qwen-Image-2.1 with LoRA (rank 64, α = 64 \alpha=64 ) on the attention projections and image MLP layers of its transformer. The input image is encoded as the condition and the model is trained with the rectified-flow velocity loss to produce the edited image.
blocks.zh: 图像模型. 我们用LORA(排名64,α=64\alpha=64)微调了Quen-Image-2.1的注意力预测及其变压器的MLP层图像. 输入图像被编码为条件,模型被训练为修正流速损失来生成被编辑的图像.

blocks.en: Video model. We fine-tune Wan2.2-TI2V-5B with LoRA of the same rank on its attention and feed-forward layers. The input state occupies the first frame and is excluded from the loss. Each clip contains 17 blocks of four frames (65 frames): block 0 shows the input, and for each of up to eight moves, a decision block shows the marked move and the next block shows its resulting state. The final state is held after the last move. At 256 pixels, one latent token covers one chess square. In chess, each decision block additionally marks the legal destination squares of the moving piece with green dots. The decoder reads the move from the blue and red squares only ( Appendix C ). The dots are used to test whether the drawn destinations match the piece’s legal moves, and the image models are trained without them.
blocks.zh: 视频模型. 微调Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 注意层和进取层的同级LORA。 输入状态占据了第一个帧并被排除在损失之外. 每个片段包含17个块的4个帧(65个帧): 第0个块显示输入,对于每个最多有8个动作,一个决定块显示被标记的移动,而下个块显示其产生的状态. 最终状态在最后动作后举行. 在256像素时,一个潜入的活物覆盖了一个象棋广场. 在国际象棋中,每个决赛都额外地以绿色点标出移动棋子的合法目的地方块. 解码器只读出从蓝色和红色正方形(附录C. 点用来检验所绘制的去向是否与作品的合法动作相匹配,而图像模型则在没有它们的情况下训练.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Training configurations for the models used in the main results.
blocks.zh: 表3:主要结果中使用的模型的培训配置。

blocks.en: Training. All runs use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , cosine decay, 200 warm-up steps, weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} and gradient clipping at 1. Table 3 lists the runs behind the main results. The image models in the main tables see only the best-move prompt. The models used for contrastive guidance ( Appendix M ), chess at one million puzzles and Go at 100,000 positions, are instead trained on a mixture of prompts: half of the examples ask for the best move, and the rest for any legal move or a plausible but losing move.
blocks.zh: 培训。 所有跑步都使用有学习率的 AdamW 10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 }, 余弦衰减, 200 个取暖步骤, 体重衰减 10 - 4 10 - 4 10 - 4 5 ) 并用 1 来剪接梯度. 表3列出了主要结果背后的运行情况。 主表格中的图像模型只看到最动的提示. 用于对比性指导(附录M),一百万个谜题和十万个入围点的棋子的模型,却被训练了各种提示的混合:一半的例子要求最佳动作,而其余的则要求任何合法动作或可能但失败的动作.

blocks.en: Appendix C Inference and evaluation

blocks.en: Sampling. The image model is sampled with a 20-step Euler flow-matching sampler, the video model with UniPC for 30 steps (flow shift 3, no classifier-free guidance).

blocks.en: Reading the action. We decode actions from pixels without using task rules. In chess, we fit the blue and red tint added to each square and select the strongest blue square as the origin and the strongest red square as the destination. The other tasks use the same principle with their respective palettes ( Appendix A ). The strongest mark of each kind determines the action regardless of its strength. We do not constrain the readout to legal actions, so an illegal action counts as a failure. For video, we average each block’s two central frames and check each decision against the board the model imagined immediately before it.

blocks.en: Majority voting. We draw 8 samples with different noise in one batch and keep the most frequent decoded move, breaking ties by sample order. For scoring, samples whose drawing is not a legal move are pooled into a single “no move” vote, which is never correct, so a prediction fails whenever this vote wins. Legality is thus checked by the evaluation only, and pooling is the stricter convention compared with the mode over raw decoded moves of Eq. 4 . In billiards, the vote is the circular median of the decoded angles and the median power. On the transformed and changed boards of Appendix E we use 4 samples.

blocks.en: Few-step sampling, majority voting and the implicit policy all beat a single full sample ( Tab. 1 ). This section shows that there are three ways of reading one object: the distribution over actions that the model learns in training. The model’s estimate of the clean output at full noise is the average of the action images, each weighted by its probability, so its strongest marks give the most likely action. One denoising step returns this average. Many steps instead turn it into a single draw from the distribution, which is right less often. We derive this from the training objective ( Sec. D.1 ), measure the distribution directly ( Sec. D.2 ), and test the consequences in chess ( Sec. D.3 ) and in the other tasks ( Sec. D.4 ). Section D.5 discusses what follows for inference.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the idea on an exact toy model with three moves of probability 0.5, 0.3 and 0.2. From every noise draw, the first estimate is the same point, the weighted average of the three move images, and its strongest mark is the most likely move. Twenty steps instead carry each noise draw to one of the three moves, in proportion to their probabilities. If the answer follows the model’s probabilities, the first estimate is right half of the time and a 20-step sample 0.5 2 + 0.3 2 + 0.2 2 = 0.38 0.5^{2}+0.3^{2}+0.2^{2}=0.38 of the time, since both the ground truth and the model must independently choose the same answer.

blocks.en: Decisions are fixed early. At every sampling step we decode the model’s current estimate of the clean output and read it like a final output. To describe how many candidates it holds, we give every legal move the product of the blue strength at its origin and the red strength at its destination, normalise over the legal moves, and count the effective number of candidates ( exp \exp of the entropy). The legal moves are used only for this count. A decision commits at the first step after which its leading move no longer changes. In every model and task, decisions commit at a median noise level of 0.93 or above ( Tab. 5 ): candidate moves differ in whole squares, far apart relative to the noise, so each sample is assigned to one of them almost immediately [ 1 , 17 ] , and the remaining steps only sharpen the image. Tasks differ in how many candidates the first estimate holds: few in pathfinding, where the target is nearly unique, and many in Go. Figure 10 shows this progression for the chess image model of Tab. 1 and the Go image model trained on one million positions. At σ = 1 \sigma=1 , each noise draw contains several partially marked moves, and within a few steps it settles on one. Each row shows the first recorded noise draw ending on its move.

blocks.en: Fewer steps, better decisions. Table 6 varies the number of steps for the models at one million puzzles on the first 4,000 test puzzles. Without guidance, fewer steps give better decisions for both models, and every subset of puzzles improves as steps are removed (by solution depth, rating, number of legal moves and number of plausible alternatives), easy and single-solution puzzles improve more than hard and multi-solution ones. Where the steps are spent matters in the same direction: at a fixed number of steps, schedules that cross the high-noise range in one large step beat those that resolve it finely (image: 36.8 against 32.4%, video: 47.8 against 42.8%), because a large first step keeps the average and lands on its most likely move, while fine steps at high noise let the noise choose. Guidance is the exception: it replaces the conditional mean by an extrapolation, so Proposition 1 no longer applies, and fewer steps do not help. Reading the strongest mark without a minimum strength ( Appendix C ) matters here: the one-step output marks moves faintly, and a reader that requires a clear mark finds no move in 51.2% of the video model’s one-step outputs.

blocks.en: Fewer steps on every task. Table 7 repeats the step comparison on every task and model. Wherever the output is a single decision, one or two steps are more accurate than full sampling: in chess, Go, Connect Four and billiards, for both models. This holds even in billiards, whose action is continuous: an average of several good shots could have been a poor shot, but it is not. Routes behave differently, and differently for the two models. The image model, which marks one move per call, is as accurate at one step on uniform maps (89.0 against 88.8% optimal routes) and on the cheapest-route metric of terrain maps, but not on the probe maps, where the cheapest route may detour around costly terrain. The video model, which draws whole route segments, loses at few steps on every route task and needs about eight steps to match full sampling. Different noise can also produce different correct solutions ( Fig. 11 ). The shortest-path map has 168 optimal routes of 17 moves. Six closed-loop runs of the image model, with one move per call and 20 steps per move, produce three distinct routes, and breadth-first search confirms that all six are optimal. In the hard Connect Four position, six of seven columns preserve Blue’s win, and the first six 20-step samples choose five different value-preserving columns.

blocks.en: Why routes need more steps. The probe set separates two failure modes ( Tab. 7 ). For the image model, every error on a map that requires a detour is a route that crosses the costly band. One step is slightly more accurate than full sampling where crossing is right (90.8 against 88.0%) and much less accurate where a detour is right (67.2 against 82.0%). This is what reading the average of Proposition 1 predicts when the model is still uncertain at full noise: a crossing is a single straight route, so its probability sits on a few cells, while a detour can take many slightly different paths, so its probability is spread over many cells. The strongest cell of the average then lies on the crossing even when detours are more likely in total, whereas full sampling first commits to one route and then follows it ( Fig. 12 ). The video model shows no such bias. At few steps its clips stop before the goal (on 172 of the 250 detour maps at one step, against 8 at full sampling), because an average of clips is not a coherent clip. Among routes that reach the goal, the share of correct choices barely changes with the number of steps. We therefore use full sampling for all route tasks in the main results.
blocks.zh: 为什么路线需要更多的步骤。 探测器设置分离出两种故障模式(Tab. 7 ) 对于图像模型来说,需要绕行的地图上的每一个错误都是穿越昂贵的波段的路径. 与完全取样相比,一个步骤的准确性略高,其中过境正确(90.8%对88.0%),绕道正确(67.2%对82.0%)则更不准确。 这就是在模型在完全噪声时仍然不确定时读取"Proposition 1"的平均值的预测:一个交叉是一个单一的直通道,所以它的概率坐落在几个细胞上,而绕道可以走许多略有不同的路径,所以它的概率被分散在许多细胞上. 平均值中最强的细胞位于过境点上,即使绕道在总体上更可能,而完整的取样首先承诺一条路线,然后遵循这条路线(图12)。 视频模型没有显示这种偏见. 它的剪接在目标之前就停止了几步(在250个绕行地图中,一个步骤有172个,而在全面取样时则有8个),因为平均剪接不是连贯的剪接. 在实现目标的路线中,正确选择的比例与步骤的数量几乎没有变化。 因此,我们在主要结果中对所有路线任务采用全面的抽样。

blocks.en: The first estimate is the model’s own distribution. Without an implicit policy, the theory can still be tested against the model’s own samples: by Eq. 7 , an action should be marked in the one-step output as strongly as the full sampler chooses it. For Go and Connect Four we drew 16 full samples per position, on 1,000 positions each ( Tab. 8 ). The mark strengths follow the sample frequencies on every model, the one-step decision agrees with the majority of the samples more often than a single sample does, and it is about as accurate as the vote over all 16 samples, at a sixteenth of the cost. In Go, the one-step output can also be compared with an external reference, the policy network of KataGo: its strongest point is KataGo’s preferred move in 34.3% of positions, against 20.0% for a 20-step output, and its strength map agrees with KataGo’s policy about twice as well (correlation 0.54 against 0.26). Figure 13 shows examples.

blocks.en: D.5 What this means for inference
blocks.zh: D. 5级 这对推断意味着什么?

blocks.en: Majority voting. Samples from different noise can propose different moves, and a vote keeps the most frequent one. Voting therefore helps in proportion to how much the samples differ. At one million puzzles, at least one of eight samples is correct on 79.0% of the puzzles for the video model, 70.0% for the image model and 62.4% with guidance, which concentrates the samples, and voting gains 10.4, 8.2 and 2.7 points ( Tab. 9 ). Few-step samples are the extreme case: they all read the same average, so they barely differ, and voting adds little to them ( Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 多数投票。 来自不同噪音的样本可以提出不同的动作,而一票保留最频繁的动作. 因此,投票与样本的不同程度成正比。 在100万个谜题中,至少8个样本中的1个在79.0%的谜题上正确,70.0%的图象模型正确,62.4%的取向将样本集中,投票结果10.4,8.2和2.7分(Tab. 9). 很少有步骤的样本是极端的例子:它们都读取相同的平均值,因此它们几乎没有差异,投票对它们没有多大增加(Tab. 1 )。

blocks.en: No search at inference. Where iterative denoising performs optimisation, more steps improve the solution and harder instances need more of them [ 19 ] . We observe the opposite on both counts: accuracy falls with more steps, and harder positions gain less, not more, from them. At equal compute, samples are worth more than steps: on the 10,000 test puzzles, one step reaches 62.5% with only one network evaluation, 20 steps 56.0% with 20, and a vote over eight 20-step samples 63.8% with 160. Look-ahead is acquired in training, as in chess models trained without search [ 18 ] , and extra computation at inference can only select among the model’s own candidates. That is also where most of the remaining headroom lies: the correct move is among the eight 20-step samples for 85.4% of the test puzzles and among the implicit policy’s three most likely moves for 88.1%, while no readout that does not use the answer exceeds 67.0%. The same holds for whole puzzles: one or more of eight 20-step samples solves 69.0% of them ( Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 不进行推断搜索。 当迭代去诺实现优化时,更多的步骤会改进解决办法,而更困难的情况需要更多的步骤[19]。 我们从两个方面都看到相反的情况:准确性随着步骤的增加而下降,而较硬的立场从中得益较少,而不是更多。 同样计算,样本的价值超过步骤:在一万个测试谜题上,一个步骤达到62.5%,只有一次网络评价,20个步骤为56.0%,8个20步的样本为63.8%,160个. Look-ahead是在训练中获得的,如同在围棋模型中训练而不用搜索[18],推想中的额外计算只能从模型自己的候选人中选择. 这也是大部分剩余房间的所在:正确的动作是85.4%测试谜题的8个20步样本,以及88.1%的隐含政策最有可能的3个动作,而没有读出没有超过67.0%的答案。 整个谜题也一样:八个20步标本中的一个或多个解决了69.0%(附录F.

blocks.en: Training at full noise only. Equation 7 makes a prediction that can be tested directly. If one step returns the average over actions, then the full-noise part of the training loss, which is plain regression of the marked image, should be enough to produce the decision. We test this on Connect Four with the same backbone, LoRA, data, prompt and steps, but with every training example at σ = 1 \sigma=1 . Read in one step, this model keeps the win on 83.5% of the hard positions, against 76.4% for the diffusion-trained model, as expected from a model that spends all of its training on the one noise level the readout uses. What it cannot provide is alternatives. Its outputs for eight noise draws agree on 98.4% of positions, so they contain a value-preserving move on only 83.9%, whereas eight 20-step samples of the diffusion-trained model, which agree on 3.7%, contain one on 94.4%. The one-step decision therefore comes from the full-noise term of the objective, as Eq. 7 states, and training across the other noise levels is what gives the same model a distribution to draw candidates from ( Fig. 11 ).
blocks.zh: 训练时只有完全噪音。 方程式7作出可以直接测试的预测. 如果一个步骤在动作上返回平均值,那么训练损失中完全噪声的部分,即标记图像的简单回归,应该足以产生决定. 我们用相同的主干,LORA,数据,即时和阶梯,在连接四上测试这个,但每个训练例子都用: == 1\ sigma=1. 在一步中读取,这个模型保持了83.5%的硬姿势的取胜率,而传播训练模型的取胜率为76.4%,正如一个将全部训练花在读取用的一个噪声级的模型所期望的那样. 它不能提供的是其他选择。 其8个噪声的产出占98.4%,因此它们只包含83.9%的保值移动,而8个20步的传播训练模型样本占3.7%,包含94.4%。 因此,一个步骤的决定来自目标全噪词,如Eq. 7所述,其他噪音级别的培训使同一模式得到分配,以吸引候选人(图11)。

blocks.en: Scope. The derivation assumes an optimal model and marks that add up. In practice the marks blur and the image decoder is nonlinear, so two-step outputs are more often illegal (8.6%) than the mispairing of Sec. D.1 explains. With guidance the model no longer predicts a conditional mean, and fewer steps do not help. The implicit policy is somewhat overconfident (expected 71.4% against a measured 67.0%), and we measured calibration on one model only. The gain of the one-step output over a single sample is larger where the samples disagree, on every model, but not significantly.
blocks.zh: 范围。 推论假设的是最佳模式和印记。 在实践中,标记模糊而图像解码器为非线性,因此两步输出比Sec.D.1的误作解释更经常是非法的(8.6%). 在引导下,模型不再预测有条件的平均值,步骤更少也无济于事. 隐含的政策有些过于自信(预期为71.4%,而测量为67.0%),我们只用一个模型来衡量校正。 单步输出在单一样本上的得益较大,因为样本在每种模型上都存在分歧,但并不显著.

blocks.en: Retrieval baselines. To compare against memorisation, we look up, for each test position, the training position with the fewest differing squares and the same side to move, among all positions on the training lines the compared model was trained on: three million for Tab. 1 , one million for Tab. 9 . Nearest training position plays that position’s move on the test board, and majority of 16 nearest plays the most common move among the 16 closest positions. Exact repeats are rare: only 17 of the 10,000 test positions occur on the three million training lines, each as a later position inside a solution line. None is the start position of a training puzzle, so none is a training input of either model. The distance to the nearest position also shows how differently the two strategies degrade. When a near-duplicate exists (at most 4 differing squares, 763 test puzzles), copying is right on 52.9% of them, the majority of 16 on 55.4% and our image model on 61.9%. With 13 to 16 differing squares (1,757 puzzles), copying drops to 8.7% but the image model solves 50.4%.

blocks.en: Symmetries. Mirroring the board left to right, or swapping the colours together with flipping the board top to bottom, maps a puzzle onto an equivalent one whose answer is the transformed original answer. We apply each transformation to 2,000 test puzzles and compare accuracy before and after. Colour swaps leave accuracy unchanged for every model (all differences within 1.2 points). Mirroring lowers it by 0.5 to 4.0 points, so this symmetry is learned only approximately.
blocks.zh: 相会相会. 镜像从左到右的棋盘,或将相色相换,将棋盘从上到下翻出,将一个谜题映射到一个等同的,其答案是被改变的原始答案. 我们把每个变换应用到2000个测试谜题,并在前后比较准确性. 色彩互换使每个模型的准确性保持不变(1.2分内的所有差异). 镜像将它降低0.5到4.0分,因此这种对称性只被大约学习.

blocks.en: One-piece changes. The strongest test changes the position so that the best move may change. For each test puzzle we remove one piece other than a king, or move it to an empty neighbouring square, without touching the squares of the original answer. Stockfish 19 at depth 18 then decides whether the change is decisive , meaning another move is now clearly best, or a control , meaning the original move is still clearly best. A model that recalls a pattern should keep its move in both cases, while a model that evaluates the new position should keep it on control boards and abandon it on decisive ones. Our image model does the latter ( Tab. 1 ). It keeps its move on 82.3% of control boards but only on 35.3% of decisive ones, and on the decisive boards it finds the new best move 39.5% of the time, against 5.1% for a random legal move. Retrieval barely reacts: the difference between control and decisive boards is 4.1 points for copying and 8.4 for the majority of 16 nearest positions, against 47.0 for our image model and 58.8 with few-step sampling. The video model at one million puzzles behaves in the same way (41.2 points, Tab. 9 ).
blocks.zh: 一品变化. 最强测试会改变位置,以便最佳动作会改变. 对于每个测试谜题,我们取出除王外的一块,或者移动到相邻的空地上,而不触及原始答案的正方. 鱼鱼19号在深度18,然后决定改变是决定性的, 意味着另一个动作现在明显最好, 还是一个控制, 意味着原来的动作仍然明显最好。 一种回顾模式的模式应在两种情况下保持其动作,而一种评价新职位的模式应将其保留在控制板上并放弃在决定性的板上. 我们的图像模型是后者(图一 ) 。 它继续运行在82.3%的控制板上,但只有35.3%的决定性控制板上,在决定性控制板上,它发现39.5%的新动作是最佳动作,随机合法动作为5.1%。 检索几乎没有反应:控制板和决定性板之间的区别是:复制4.1分,16个最近位置的大多数8.4分,而我们的图像模型是47.0分,只有58.8分,没有多少步骤。 100万个谜题的视频模型表现方式相同(41.2分,Tab. 9.

Left: examples for each change and model. Models that predict again after every move avoid the new wall, while a clip drawn before the change walks into it. blocks.zh: 图14:改变地图的中途路线。 在三分之一的路由后,对金细胞做了一次更改:一面墙出现在下个地槽上,一面更便宜的捷径会从前泥地或沙地上打开,一面墙会从路由外出作为控制. 左:每个更改和模型的示例. 每次动作后再次预测的模型会避开新墙,而在变化走入前所绘制的片段会进入其中. 右:最便宜(95%间隔)的变相图路线的分数.

blocks.en: Changing the map during a route. We also changed the map once in the middle of a route. On the first 250 terrain test maps, each model walks from the start. After a third of its route, at least two moves before the goal, we either place a wall on the cell it would enter next, or turn mud or sand into floor so that a strictly cheaper route appears that the old route does not use. Changes of the same size away from every cheapest route serve as controls, and the episode continues on the changed map with the same sampling noise. Figure 14 shows one map per change. When a wall appears on the next cell (left column), the image closed loop and the video receding horizon read the new state, turn away from the wall and follow a cheapest route of the changed map, while executing an already drawn video clip walks straight into the wall. When a shortcut opens (middle column), the closed loop takes it. In this example the receding horizon reaches the goal on a costlier route. A wall away from the route (right column) leaves all routes unchanged. Over all maps ( Tab. 10 ), the two loops reach the goal after the wall in 98% of episodes, never enter it, and end on a cheapest route about as often as without the change. When a shortcut opens, they take it in 82 and 80% of episodes, against 10 and 19% for their old routes. Executing whole clips does not adapt: the drawn moves walk into the new wall in every episode, and only 11% of shortcut episodes end on the new cheapest route, because the model sees the change only at its next clip.
blocks.zh: 在路径中更改地图 。 我们还在路线中间改变了一次地图。 在前250个地形测试地图上,每个模型从起步. 在它三分之一的路线,至少两步后,在入球前,我们要么在它接下来进入的细胞上放置一堵墙,要么把泥或沙变成地上,这样,一个严格便宜的路线看起来是旧路线不使用的. 与每个最便宜的路线相去甚远的同大小的改变作为控制,剧集在被改变的地图上继续使用相同的采样噪音. 图14显示每个变化一张地图。 当下个单元格(左栏)上出现一堵墙时,图像闭合回路和视频折返地平线读取了新状态,从墙上转出并遵循被修改的地图的最廉价路线,同时执行已经绘制的视频剪辑会直接走入墙中. 当一个快捷键打开时(中间一栏),闭合的回路取取. 在这个例子中,缩小的地平线在成本更高的路线上达到了目标。 远离路线的一堵墙(右栏)使所有路线保持不变. 在所有地图上(Tab. 10),两个环路在98%的剧集中到达了墙后的目标,从不进入,并且以最廉价的路线结束,大概是没有变化的频率. 当一条捷径打开时,他们会在82%和80%的剧集中取而代之,而旧路线则取而代之的是10%和19%. 执行整段剪辑不适应:所绘制的动作会走入每集的新墙上,只有11%的捷径剧集会以最便宜的新路线结束,因为模型只在下集剪辑时才看到变化.

Entries give the percentage of episodes whose remaining route from the change point is a cheapest one on the changed map, among the episodes that reach that point. Italic rows show the same model and maps without a change. Because the measure starts at the change point, the first row is higher than the whole-route accuracy of Tab. 2 . “Clip” executes each drawn clip in full.
blocks.zh: 表10:第一批250个地道试验地图上更换地道中段地图. 条目给出了从变化点算起的剩余路线在变化地图上最便宜的集的百分比,在到达该点的集中. 斜体行显示相同的模型和地图,没有变化. 由于测量从变化点开始,第一行比Tab的全程精度要高. 2. " 剪接 " 将每个剪辑全部执行。

blocks.en: One million puzzles, guidance and the video model. Table 9 repeats Tab. 1 at one million training puzzles, where both the image model (with and without contrastive guidance, Appendix M ) and the video model are available, together with retrieval from the same million puzzles. Every conclusion of the main table holds at this scale for all model variants. The models are far more accurate than copying, also far from training (26.3 to 46.4% against 6.9 and 15.4%), are unaffected by colour swaps, and keep their move on control boards much more often than on decisive ones, while retrieval barely tells the two apart. At equal data, the video model is the strongest of our single-sample predictors (41.7%, against 39.9% for the image model trained on the best-move prompt alone, and 31.8 and 40.9% for the mixture-trained image model without and with guidance, Appendix M ), and it gains most from voting (52.1%), because its samples are more diverse ( Sec. D.5 ). Comparing the two scales shows how differently the two strategies use data: tripling the training set raises copying from 15.3 to 18.6% (majority of 16: 23.6 to 27.0%), but the image model trained on the best-move prompt alone from 39.9 to 56.0%.
blocks.zh: 100万个谜题,指导和视频模型. 表9重复了 Tab. 1分为一百万个训练谜题,可同时提供图像模型(有和没有对比指导,附录M)和视频模型,以及从同百万个谜题取回. 主表的每个结论对所有模型变体都保持这个尺度. 这些模型比复制精度要高得多,也远非训练(26.3%至46.4%对6.9%和15.4%),它们不受色相交换的影响,而且它们在控制板上的动作比在决定性板上的动作要多得多,而检索则几乎无法区分两者。 在同等数据中,视频模型是我国单一样本预测器中最强的(41.7%,而仅接受过最佳移动快取训练的图像模型为39.9%;在没有和没有指导的情况下,在附录M中接受过混合物训练的图像模型为31.8%和40.9%),它从投票中获得的收益最大(52.1%),因为其样本更为多样(Sec.D.5)。 比较这两个尺度,可以发现这两个战略使用数据的不同之处:将培训套件三分之一的复制率从15.3%提高到18.6%(多数为16:23.6%提高到27.0%),但仅最快速移动的图像模型就从39.9%提高到56.0%。

blocks.en: Lichess counts a puzzle as solved only when every solver move is correct. We evaluate all 10,000 test puzzles under this rule. The first prediction uses the puzzle position, and later predictions use the true board after each recorded opponent reply, regardless of earlier predictions. This adds 15,679 later input positions. Neither model is trained to predict from them: the image model trains only on first positions, while the video model draws each line from its first position.
blocks.zh: Liches将谜题算作只有在每次解题动作正确时才解出. 根据这项规则,我们评估所有一万个测试谜题。 第一个预测使用谜题位置,后来的预测使用每个被记录的对手回复后的真板,不管之前的预测. 这增加了15 679个后来的投入位置。 两个模型都没有经过训练从中预测:图像模型只在先行位置上进行列车,而视频模型则从先行位置上取出每行.

blocks.en: Table 11 : Whole-puzzle results for the models in Tab. 1 on 10,000 test puzzles (%). Later moves are predicted from the true board after the recorded opponent reply. “Any of n n ” means that at least one of n n samples is correct.
blocks.zh: 表11: Tab. 1中的模型在一万个测试谜题上的全拼图结果(%). 后期动作会在被记录的对手回复后从真板上预测出. “任何n-”是指至少一个n-样本是正确的。

blocks.en: One step gives the most accurate single readout for whole puzzles as well as first moves: solve rates are 38.3 and 40.5%, versus 31.1 and 31.9% with full sampling ( Tab. 11 ). Although trained only on first positions, the image model is similarly accurate on later and first moves (62.8 versus 62.5%). Whole-puzzle success exceeds the rate predicted by independent moves (38.3 versus 33.1%), indicating that difficulty tends to persist across a puzzle. The solve rate ranges from 89.8% below rating 1000 to 3.8% above 2500. Full sampling provides broader candidate coverage: at least one of eight samples at 20 steps solves 69.0% of puzzles, compared with 45.2% for eight one-step samples, which read nearly the same average.
blocks.zh: 一个步骤给出了整个谜题最准确的单一读出以及第一个动作:解析率是38.3%和40.5%,而满分抽样的解析率是31.1%和31.9%。 虽然只接受了先行位置的培训,但后行和后行的图像模型同样准确(62.8%对62.5%). 整个谜题的成功率超过了独立动作预想的速率(38.3%对33.1%),表明难度往往会贯穿一个谜题. 解析率从低于1000分的89.8%到高于2500分的3.8%. 完整的采样提供了更广泛的候选覆盖:在20个步骤的8个样本中,至少有1个解决了69.0%的谜题,而8个一步取出样本的45.2%读取了几乎相同的平均值.

blocks.en: Grouped by the number of our moves in the recorded solution, the one-step video model solves 92.2, 49.4, 25.8 and 12.3% of puzzles with one, two, three and four or more moves, respectively (image: 90.2, 47.0, 23.6 and 11.4%). Whole-puzzle success falls further from three to four or more moves even though the video’s first-move accuracy is nearly unchanged (57.4 versus 57.1%).
blocks.zh: 按我们所记录的解决方案中的动作数分组,单步视频模型分别用一,二,三和四等动作解决了92.2,49.4,25.8%和12.3%的谜题(图像:90.2,47.0,23.6%和11.4%). 尽管影片的第一动精度几乎没有变化(57.4%对57.1%),

blocks.en: Are wrong moves alternative solutions? A move outside the recorded solution may still be equally good. We compare each such move with the solution using Stockfish 19 at a fixed budget of 16M nodes per position. A move qualifies if it preserves a forced mate whenever the solution has one, or otherwise loses at most 5 points of win probability, the Lichess inaccuracy threshold. Alternatives are rare: another legal move qualifies in only 0.2% of first positions and 0.7% of later ones. Counting equally good model moves as correct raises per-move accuracy by at most 0.4 points and whole-puzzle solve rates from 38.3 to 38.8% for the image model and from 40.5 to 40.9% for video.
blocks.zh: 是否错误的移动替代解决方案 ? 在有记录的解决方案之外采取行动可能仍然同样良好。 我们用"鱼"19的解决方案来比较每个这样的动作,固定预算为每个位置16M节点. 如果在溶液有1个时保留了被强迫的配偶,或者在最多5分的胜概率下丧失了Liches的不准确阈值,那么移动就有资格。 替代品很少见:另一种合法举措仅符合0.2%的初始职位和0.7%的后期职位。 将同样好的模型动作计算为正确提高了每起运动的精度,在最多0.4分时,整个谜题解析率从图像模型的38.3%到38.8%,从视频的40.5%到40.9%.

blocks.zh: 附录G 谜题需要多少外观?

blocks.en: Table 12 : First-move accuracy (%) of the models of Tab. 1 by the shallowest Stockfish search depth at which the engine’s best move is the puzzle answer. The one-ply rule plays a mate, otherwise the best capture, otherwise a check. On seven puzzles the engine does not play the answer at any depth up to 30, six of them mates in one with another equally good mate, and they are left out.
blocks.zh: 表12:Tab模型的第一移动精确度(%)。 以最浅的鱼群搜索深度为1, 单ply规则扮演一个伴侣,否则最佳捕捉,否则就是支票. 在7个谜题上,引擎不会在任何深度的30分以内播放答案,其中6个和另一个同样好的伴侣交配,被排除在外.

blocks.en: Accuracy by required search depth. Rating and solution length only approximate how much lookahead a puzzle requires. We therefore label each test puzzle with the shallowest depth at which Stockfish 19’s best move is the puzzle answer (one thread, fixed hash, depth at most 30) and group first-move accuracy by this depth ( Tab. 12 ). The engine already plays the answer at depth 1 on 7,748 puzzles. Depth 1 is not a one-move rule, however: the engine still follows captures until the position is quiet and scores the result with a network trained on deeper searches, and a rule that plays a mate, the best capture or a check finds only 42.3% of these answers, against 69.2% for the one-step video model. On the 462 puzzles that need depth 6 or more, which are also much harder for human solvers (mean rating 2232 against 1649), the video model is right 42.2% of the time and the image model 38.3%, against 20.6% for the one-ply rule, 18.0% for the majority move of the 16 nearest training positions and 4.9% for a random legal move. Accuracy drops once the answer is no longer the engine’s immediate choice, but it does not keep falling as the required depth grows from 2 to 30, and much of the drop reflects puzzle rating: within rating bands, these deep puzzles are solved 2.4 points less often than the others by the video model and 8.3 by the image model. The 139 deep puzzles tagged as sacrifices behave alike (42.4% for the video model, at most 22.3% for any baseline). Connect Four, where an exact solver gives the number of moves to a forced win, shows the same pattern: the one-step image model keeps the win on 81.5, 84.9, 79.5 and 72.5% of hard positions won in 1–3, 4–7, 8–11 and 12 or more of our moves, 14 to 21 points above the one-move heuristic in every group. The models thus stay well above shallow rules on positions that an engine solves only by searching deep, although they run no search.
blocks.zh: 以所需的搜索深度精确度 。 评分和解析长度只大致相当于一个谜题需要多少外观。 因此,我们用最浅的深度标出每个测试谜题,斯托克鱼19的最佳动作是谜题解答(一线、固定散列、深度最多为30个),并以这一深度标出第一组精确度(第12分)。 引擎已经在7,748个谜题的深度1上播放了答案. 然而深度一号并不是一动规则,引擎仍然跟随抓取,直到位置安静,并且通过接受更深搜索训练的网络对结果进行分分,而玩伴,最佳抓取或检查的规则只发现42.3%的这些答案,而单步视频模型则只有69.2%. 在需要深度6或更深的462个谜题上,这些谜题对于人类的解题者来说也困难得多(平均评分为2232对1649),视频模型的正确时间为42.2%,图像模型为38.3%,而一推规则为20.6%,16个最接近的训练职位中的多数移动为18.0%,随机合法移动为4.9%. 一旦答案不再是引擎的即时选择,准确度会下降,但不会随着要求的深度从2到30不断下降而持续下降,而下降的大部分反映了谜题的评级:在评级波段内,这些深层谜题被视频模型解出2.4分的频率比其他的要少,被图像模型解出8.3分. 139个深层谜题标记为牺牲行为相同(视频模型为42.4%,任何基线最多为22.3%)。 Connect Four,一个精确的解答者给出了向强制取胜的动作次数,呈现出同样的模式:一步图像模型将取胜保持在81.5,84.9,79.5和72.5%的硬姿势上,在1–3,4–7,8–11和12个或更多动作中取胜,在每组单步高血压以上14–21分. 因此,这些模型在引擎只能通过深入搜索才能解决的位置上远远高于浅层规则,尽管它们没有进行搜索。

blocks.en: The one-ply rule and sacrifices. On the three test sets of Tab. 1 , the one-ply rule finds 38.0% of the answers on all puzzles, 26.8% on sacrifices and 33.6% far from training, against 63.9, 55.6 and 59.1% for the one-step video model. The sacrifice tag describes the whole solution, so we also check the moves themselves. By static exchange evaluation, our side gives up material somewhere in the solution on 857 of the 1,001 sacrifice puzzles and on the first move itself on 699. On these 699, the video and image models find the move 52.6 and 48.2% of the time, against at most 26.6% for the rule and the copying baselines.
blocks.zh: 独取一法而取牺牲. 在Tab. 1的三套测试中,一推规则在所有谜题上发现38.0%的答案,26.8%的答案是牺牲的答案,33.6%的答案是远离训练的,而单步视频模型的答案为63.9,55.6%和59.1%. 牺牲标记描述了整个解决方案,所以我们也检查了动作本身. 通过静态交换评估,我们一方放弃了1 001个牺牲谜题中的857个解决方案中的某地材料,以及699年的首次行动。 在这些699上,视频和图像模型发现移动时间为52.6%和48.2%,而规则和复制基线最多为26.6%.

blocks.en: Table 13 : One-step first-move accuracy (%) of the models of Tab. 1 by how the puzzle ends.
blocks.zh: 表13: Tab 模型的单步第一移动精度(%). 1 依谜题的结局。

blocks.en: Accuracy by how a puzzle ends. First moves that start a forced mate are found more often than others, and less often as the mate gets longer ( Tab. 13 ). Even for mates in four or more moves, both models find the first move on 64.4% of puzzles, above their accuracy on puzzles without a mate.
blocks.zh: 通过谜题的结束来准确度. 开始强制伴侣的第一个动作比其他动作更频繁地被发现,而随着伴侣变长而少见(Tab 13.). 即使对4个或4个以上动作的配方来说,两个模型都会在64.4%的谜题上发现第一个动作,在没有配方的谜题上都超过了它们的精度.
