blocks.en: Figure 5 in the main paper shows which pieces a chess decision depends on. We test this over many positions with the models at one million puzzles, on puzzles of two kinds: an enemy piece can be won, or the enemy king can be attacked. For the video model, attention from the decision frame to the piece that can be won is 1.13 times chance, against 0.86 for the other enemy pieces, and it stays higher after controlling for visual saliency (which squares hold pieces and which squares the move itself uses). In mate puzzles, the enemy king’s zone receives 1.00 times chance against 0.89 in the other puzzles, whereas the pretrained model gives it 1.10 in both: fine-tuning makes attention depend on what the puzzle is about. Removing pieces confirms this causally: removing the piece that can be won lowers the strength of the chosen move by 0.61, removing another enemy piece by 0.02. For the image model, removing pieces shows the same dependence (0.67 against 0.05), but its attention does not. The piece that can be won receives more attention than the other pieces (1.15 against 1.05 times chance), but the pretrained model shows the same contrast, and attention to the king’s zone does not differ between the two kinds of puzzle. The image model’s decisions thus depend on the right pieces, but its attention maps do not show it.
blocks.zh: 主论文中图5显示棋子决定取决于哪些棋子. 我们用100万个谜题来测试这些模型的很多位置,在两种谜题上:一个敌人的棋子可以取胜,或者敌人的国王可以被攻击. 对于视频模型来说,从决定框到可以取胜的作品的注意力是1.13倍的机会,而其他敌人的作品则是0.86,在控制了视觉亮度(平方有片而动作本身使用的平方)后,它会保持更高的. 在交配谜题中,敌王区与其他谜题中0.89比得到1.00倍的机会,而预先训练的模型则给予它1.10两种:微调让注意力取决于谜题的内容. 删除棋子证实了这个因果关系:去除可以取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 对于图像模型来说,去除片段显示出相同的依赖性(0.67对0.05),但其注意力却并非如此. 可以取胜的棋子比其他棋子获得更多的关注(1.15比1.05的概率),但被预先训练的模型表现出了相同的对比,对国王区的关注在两种谜题之间没有区别. 因此,图像模型的决定取决于正确的部分,但其注意力图并没有显示。

blocks.en: Pathfinding allows a cleaner test because relevance is easy to define. Attention from the decision to the cells of the chosen route is above chance and above matched off-route cells for both video models (ratios 1.10 to 1.14), and the effect comes from fine-tuning. For the image models, attention to the route is at chance. On terrain maps, all three models attend more to the costly cells their route avoids than to matched floor cells, which shows that they look at the obstacles that shape the route. The counterfactual tests of Appendix E show the causal side: a wall on the chosen cell, or removing the terrain the route avoids, changes the decision, while the same change elsewhere does not.
blocks.zh: 寻找路径可以进行更清洁的测试,因为相关性很容易定义. 从决定到所选择路线的单元格的注意度高于偶然性,高于两个视频模型的离线单元格(ratios 1.10至 1.14),效果来自微调. 对于图像模型来说,注意路线是偶然的. 在地形图上,所有三种模型都更关注它们所避免的昂贵的细胞,而不是匹配的地表细胞,这表明它们关注形成路径的障碍. 附录E的反事实测试显示了因果的一面:所选单元格上的一面墙,或者去除路线所避开的地形,改变决定,而其他地方的相同变化则不改变.

blocks.en: Appendix I Probing for lookahead
blocks.zh: 附录一 探查前方

blocks.en: The implicit policy shows that the image model distinguishes good moves from bad ones. Because move quality often depends on what follows, we ask whether the model represents future moves internally even though training asks it to draw only its own move.
blocks.zh: 隐含的政策表明,图像模型区分出好动和坏动. 因为移动质量往往取决于接下来的情况,我们问这个模型是否代表了未来的内部移动,尽管培训要求它只画出自己的动作.

blocks.en: Features. We run the unguided image model at one million puzzles exactly as at evaluation time and record the output of transformer blocks 8, 16, 24 and 32 (of 32) at sampling steps 0, 4 and 10 ( σ \sigma = 1.00, 0.86 and 0.60). Each board square covers 2 × 2 2{\times}2 image tokens, and we average them into one 4,096-dimensional vector per square.
blocks.zh: 特征 我们以100万个与评价时间完全相同的谜题运行无制导图像模型,并在0、4和10的取样步骤中记录变压器区块8、16、24和32(32个中的)的输出(\sigma=1.00、0.86和0.60)。 每个板子平方包含2×2 2×2×2}}2个图像符,我们平均每个平方为1个4,096维矢量.

blocks.en: Targets. The puzzle’s solution gives three sets of squares: those of our first move, which the model draws, of the opponent’s reply and of our follow-up. For the reply we leave out the squares of the first move, and for the follow-up those of the first two moves. Otherwise a probe could succeed simply by finding the painted mark, for example when the reply recaptures on the destination square of our move.
blocks.zh: 目标 这个谜题的解决方案给出了三组方块:我们第一次行动,模型所绘制的,对手的答复和我们的后续行动。 关于答复,我们不提第一个步骤的正方形,以及前两个步骤的后续方形。 否则,一个探测器只要找到所画的标记就可以成功,例如当答复重新出现在我们行动的目的地广场上时。

blocks.en: Probe and selection. The probe is a single logistic-regression layer, shared by all squares, that maps a square’s standardised vector to the probability that the square belongs to the target move. For each position, it ranks the candidate squares, and we score this ranking by its average precision. Probes are trained on 20,000 puzzles from training rows the model never saw. The block, the noise level and the regularisation are chosen on 1,834 validation puzzles, and only the chosen probe is evaluated, once, on 3,679 test puzzles.
blocks.zh: 探取与选取. 探测器是一个单一的后勤后退层,由所有方块共享,将方块的标准化矢量映射到方块属于目标移动的概率. 对于每个职位,它都会对候选方位进行排名,我们以平均精确度来评分这一排名. 探测器被训练了两万个谜题 从训练的行 模型从未见过。 在1,834个验证谜题上选择了块,噪声级别和正则化,只有所选择的探测器在3,679个测试谜题上得到一次评价.

blocks.en: Baselines. A probe could also succeed because the reply is easy to guess. To rule this out, we train the same probe on four other inputs. The first describes the board: for each square, the piece on every square of a 15 × 15 15{\times}15 window around it, and the side to move. The second adds the true first move to this description, so that the probe knows what the model would play. The third uses the pretrained model’s features, and the fourth pairs our model’s features with the labels of a different position.
blocks.zh: 基线。 探测器也可以成功,因为答案很容易猜到. 为了排除这种情况,我们在另外4个输入器上进行同样的探测。 第一个描述板:每个正方形上,每个正方形上都有一个15×15 15 ×times}15个窗口围绕,并有一面可以移动. 第二作将真实的第一动作添加到这个描述中,使探测器知道模型会演奏什么. 第三种是使用预先训练过的模型的特性,第四种是将我们的模型的特性同不同位置的标签相配.

blocks.en: Table 14 : Test-set average precision (%) for the future-move probes. “Gain” is measured against the best baseline. The 95% intervals are [+6.0, +7.9] for the reply and [+4.7, +6.7] for the follow-up.
blocks.zh: 表14:未来移动探测器的测试定出平均精度(%). “Gain”是根据最佳基准测量的。 95%的间隔是答复[+6.0,+7.9]和后续行动[+4.7,+6.7]。

blocks.en: Results. The fine-tuned model’s features predict both future moves better than any baseline, including a board description that contains the true first move ( Tab. 14 ). Pretrained features perform about as well as the board description, indicating that fine-tuning adds the predictive information. Both moves are most readable at block 16, midway through the network, and are already readable at the first sampling step. For the reply, average precision is 47.8 at σ = 1 \sigma=1 and 46.9 at σ = 0.6 \sigma=0.6 .
blocks.zh: 结果。 微调模型的特性预言两个未来的动作都比任何基线要好,包括包含真实第一动作的板面描述(Tab. 14. 预受训练的特性表现得和董事会描述一样,表明微调会增加预测信息. 这两种动作在中途穿过网络的16号区块最可读取,在第一个采样步骤上已经可以读取. 对于答复,平均精度为:"一"为:"一"="一";"一"为:"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一"为:"一";"一"为:"一";"一"为:".

blocks.en: Appendix J The video model’s imagined future
blocks.zh: 附录J 视频模型的想象未来

blocks.en: The probes in Appendix I detect information about future moves inside the image model. The video model renders that future explicitly: after each decision, it draws the resulting board and the opponent’s reply. We assess the accuracy of these imagined states and moves, and their relationship to the initial decision. Whether generating a continuation improves that decision is examined in Appendix K .
blocks.zh: 附录一中的探测器探测到未来在图像模型内移动的信息. 视频模式使这一未来变得明确:在每个决定之后,它会绘制结果的板子和对手的答复. 我们评估这些想象中的状态和动作的准确性,以及它们与最初决定的关系. 产生延续是否改进了这一决定,见附录K。

blocks.en: Table 15 : Accuracy of the video model’s imagined line on 10,000 test puzzles (%). Plies 2 to 4 are scored on the puzzles whose solution has that ply (9,141 for plies 2 and 3, and 4,594 for ply 4). A move counts as correct only when its raw drawing is legal on the imagined board and matches the puzzle move, so a clip that stops early counts as wrong. Imagined boards are scored after legal drawn moves.
blocks.zh: 表15:视频模型在一万个测试谜题上的想象线的准确性(%). 2至4页被打入谜题上,其解题有:ply (9,141页为2和3页;4,594页为4页)。 一个动作只有在它的生动画在所想的棋盘上合法,并且与拼图动作相匹配时才会算作正确,所以一个片段可以停止早期算作错误. 想象中的棋盘是经过合法取出后得分的.

blocks.en: How good is the imagined line? On 10,000 test puzzles, the video model trained on one million puzzles predicts the first move correctly 41.7% of the time ( Tab. 15 ). Later moves are decoded from the model’s own imagined boards, so errors accumulate. Given a correct first move, the imagined reply matches the puzzle in 40.9% of cases. Given two correct moves, the model’s follow-up matches in 39.5%. Even when a reply differs from the puzzle, it can be reasonable: after a correct first move, 51.4% are Stockfish’s best replies and 63.6% are within two points of win probability. The imagined boards are also accurate: after a legal drawn move, all 64 squares are correct in 93.6 to 99.1% of cases, depending on the ply.
blocks.zh: 想象中的线有多好? 在一万个测试谜题上,接受过一百万个谜题训练的视频模型预测第一个动作正确41.7%的时间(Tab. 15. 后来的动作从模型自己的所想象的板被解码出,所以错误会累积. 在40.9%的案件中, 由于两个正确的动作,该模型的跟进比分为39.5%. 即便回答与谜题不同,也是合理的:经过正确的第一动作后,51.4%是斯托克鱼的最佳回答,63.6%在胜出概率的两分之内. 所想象的棋盘也是准确的:经过合法抽取的动作后,所有64个正方形在93.6%到99.1%的病例中都是正确的,具体取决于ply.

blocks.en: The video clip is resolved in order. The video model denoises every frame jointly, without an imposed temporal order, yet later boards tend to settle later. Relative to the board after the first move, the boards after the second, third, and fourth moves settle later in 54, 74, and 90% of clips. This pattern follows the dependence between frames: a later board remains uncertain while earlier moves are unresolved. Indeed, when two first moves compete at high noise, the first imagined board blends their resulting positions, and as one move fades, so does its board. The model then resolves the next board, followed by later ones. This complements the early decision commitment in Sec. D.3 and shows that the clip is drawn as one dependent line of play and not as independent frames. It is a tendency, not a strict order: some later boards settle together with or before the first move.
blocks.zh: 视频片段按顺序解决. 视频模型将每个相框都一并取出,没有强制的时序,而后板往往会在后期解决. 相较于第一动后板,第二动后板,第三动后板和第四动后板在后期54,74分和90%的剪辑中落地. 这种模式遵循了帧之间的依赖性:后期棋盘仍然不确定,而更早的动作尚未解决. 事实上,当两个最初的动作在高噪声下竞争时,第一个想象中的棋盘会混合它们由此而来的位置,随着一动的消失,它的棋盘也会随之消失. 模型再解决下个板子,再解决后一个板子. 这补充了早期在Sec.D.3中的决定承诺,并表明片段被绘制为一行依附的游戏线而并非独立帧. 这是一种趋势,而不是严格的命令:一些后来的董事会与第一次搬迁一起或在此之前就定居。

blocks.en: Figure 15 : The clip is resolved in order. Left: one chess clip of the video model at three noise levels, shown as its unaltered estimates of the boards after moves 1 to 4. A frame marks a board that has settled. Right: share of clips in which each board has settled, against the noise level. Relative to the board after move 1, the boards after moves 2, 3 and 4 settle later in 54, 74 and 90% of clips.
blocks.zh: 图15:片段按顺序解决. 左:视频模型分出三个噪声级别的一个棋盘,显示为一至四动后对棋盘的未变估计. 一个框架标志着一个已经解决的板。 右:每块板已结算的剪辑比例,与噪音水平相对. 相对于一号动后板,二号,三号,四号动后板以54分,74分和90%的片段后期结算.

blocks.en: Wishful thinking. After a wrong first move, the model tends to imagine a reply that makes its move look better than it is. We evaluate legal imagined replies on the true resulting board, ranking all opponent replies with Stockfish 19 at depth 12. The imagined reply is best in 51.4% of puzzles after a correct first move but only 28.6% after a wrong one, when the best reply is usually a refutation (Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test stratified by how forced the position is, p < 10 − 100 p<10^{-100} ). Relative to the best reply, the imagined one leaves the moving side’s win probability 35.9 points higher after a wrong move and 3.8 points higher after a correct move. Thus, an error often comes with an imagined continuation in which that error appears to work, rather than an independent check of the move.
blocks.zh: 发愿想. 在一次错误的第一动作后,模型往往会想象出一个让动作看起来比它更好的回复. 我们评价法律上想象得到的答案 在真正的结果板上, 排名所有对手的答复 与鱼鱼19 在深度12。 想象中的答案最好在51.4%的谜题中,经过一次正确的第一次行动,但只有28.6%的答案是错的,当时最好的答案通常是反驳(Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel测试分级,按该位置的强迫程度排列,p < 10–100 p < 10^{-100})。 相对于最佳的回答,想象中的一个在错误的举动后使移动方的取胜概率高出35.9分,在正确的举动后会高出3.8分. 因此,一个错误往往伴随着一种想象中的延续,这种错误似乎起作用,而不是对移动进行独立检查。

blocks.zh: 附录K 预测前景

blocks.en: We examine whether drawing a continuation improves the first move, what drives any gain, whether the model consults its imagined future at inference, and when the drawn moves should be executed. This extends the “Learning from the continuation” analysis in Sec. 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们检查画出续作是否改进了第一个动作,什么能推动任何收益,模型是否在推想中参考其想象的未来,以及何时应该执行所画动作. 这扩展了第4节中的“继续学习”分析。

blocks.en: Table 16 : First-move accuracy (%) after training with or without a continuation, using the same data and training budget. Chess: 10,000 test puzzles. Terrain: 1,000 test maps, scored on the cost-optimal first move. Connect Four: value-preserving first move on 1,000 hard positions. p p values are exact McNemar tests.
blocks.zh: 表16:使用相同数据和培训预算,在培训完成或未完成之后的第一移动精确度(%)。 国际象棋:一万个测试谜题. Terrain:1000个测试地图,在成本-最佳第一动作上得分. 接通4:在1000个硬位置上首先移动保值. p值是精确的麦克尼玛测试.

blocks.en: Training with the continuation. We compare targets that contain only the first decision and resulting state ( first move only ) with targets containing the reference continuation of up to eight moves, including opponent replies ( Eq. 2 ). Data, training steps, learning rate, and seed are identical, and in chess both targets draw the green legal-destination dots ( Appendix B ). Evaluation scores only the first decision. For the image model, the continuation target is a whole-route image ( H = L H=L ). We execute its first move, render the resulting state, and call the model again, comparing it with a one-move model trained for the same 8k steps. At every training access the one-move model draws a position along the route and predicts the next move from it, so it sees the same route decisions that the whole-route model draws at once. Continuation training improves first-move accuracy in chess at every data size and in terrain pathfinding for both models ( Tab. 16 ). Even after three times as much training (24k steps), the one-move terrain image model reaches 94.5%, below the whole-route model’s 97.3% at 8k steps ( p = 4 ⋅ 10 − 4 p=4\cdot 10^{-4} ). Connect Four is an exception: the models are indistinguishable on the hard test set, and the first-move-only model is better on the standard set (69.1 versus 65.8%, p = 2 ⋅ 10 − 4 p=2\cdot 10^{-4} ). Because its training lines come from an exact solver, noisy continuations do not explain this limit.
blocks.zh: 继续训练。 我们比较了只包含第一个决定和结果状态(仅包含第一个动作)的目标与包含最多8个动作的参考续作,包括对手回答(Eq. 2 ) 。 数据、训练步骤、学习率和种子是相同的,在围棋中,两个目标都绘制出绿色的法定命题(附录B ) 。 评价只给第一个决定打分。 对于图像模型,续作目标为全程图像(H=L H=L. 我们执行它的第一个动作, 使结果状态, 并再次调用模型, 比较它的一动模型 训练为相同的8k步骤。 在每次训练访问时,一行模型会绘制出沿途位置并预测从中下一步的移动,因此它看到与全行道模型同时绘制的路线决定相同. 继续培训提高了每种数据大小的棋子和两种型号的地道测量的先行精度(图16)。 即使经过了三倍的训练(24k步),单行道地形图像模型也达到了94.5%,低于全行道模型的97.3%,在8k步上(p = 4 — — 10 – 4 p= 4\cdot 10~4 } ) 。 连接四是例外:这些模型在硬测试集上是无法区分的,而单行道模型在标准集上更好(69.1比65.8%,p = 2 — — 10 – 4 p=2\cdot 10~4 }) 。 由于它的训练线来自精确的解析器,所以噪音的续作无法解释这一限制。

blocks.en: For the video model trained on one million puzzles and evaluated with 30 sampling steps, continuation training improves first-move accuracy by 14.7, 8.3, 6.5 and 6.3 points on puzzles with one, two, three and four or more of our moves in the recorded solution. The gain spans all four groups and is largest on the one-move puzzles.
blocks.zh: 对于经过100万个谜题培训并用30个取样步骤加以评价的视频模型,继续培训用我们记录的解决方案中的一、二、三和四个或更多动作,在谜题上以14.7、8.3、6.5和6.3分提高第一移动精度。 收益跨越了所有四个组,在一动谜题上是最大的.

blocks.en: The same decisions as separate examples. A model trained on the continuation also sees more labelled decisions per example, so we compare it with controls that receive the same decisions as separate first-move examples. For the terrain image model, the one-move model already is such a control, since it trains on every position along the route: at the same compute it reaches 83.1% against 97.3%, and 94.5% with three times the training. For the terrain video model, we train a first-move-only model on every route decision of the same segments as separate examples, with the same 5k steps. It reaches 85.3%, against 82.5% for the first move only and 95.0% with the continuation ( p = 4 ⋅ 10 − 18 p=4\cdot 10^{-18} against the continuation model), which closes about a fifth of the gap. In chess, with 80,000 lines, the same control at equal compute reaches 6.3%, below both the first move only (8.7%) and the continuation (11.0%, p = 4 ⋅ 10 − 54 p=4\cdot 10^{-54} ). When its training is extended 2.3 times, so that every decision is seen once, it reaches 12.0%, one point above the continuation model. The delayed-cue fork below gives the same answer in a controlled setting. At the same compute, drawing the continuation is therefore a more efficient training signal than the same decisions given separately. Separate examples need 2.3 times the training to match it in chess, and do not match it with three times the training on terrain.
blocks.zh: 决定与单独的例子相同。 对续作训练的模型也看到每个例子中贴有更多标签的决定,因此我们把它与接受与单独第一动例相同的决定的控制进行比较. 对于地形图像模型来说,一动模型已经是一个这样的控制,因为它在沿途的每一个位置上进行训练:在同一计算中,它达到了83.1%相对于97.3%,94.5%的训练是训练的三倍。 对于地形视频模型,我们在同一个部分的每个路由决定上,作为单独的例子,训练一个只有一动的模型,有相同的5k步. 它达到了85.3%,而只有82.5%的第一步,95.0%的续作(p = 4 → 10 – 18 p = 4\cdot 10 → 18)与续作模式相对抗,这缩小了大约五分之一的差距. 在有80,000行的围棋中,等分计算时的同一控制能达到6.3%,分别低于首发(8.7%)和续发(11.0%,p = 4 → 10 – 54 p = 4\cdot 10 → 54}. 当它的训练被延长了2.3次,以便每个决定都能看到一次时,它达到12.0%,比续作模型高出一分. 下面的延迟- cue分叉在一个受控的环境下给出了相同的答案. 因此,在同样的计算中,绘制续作比单独作出同样的决定更有效率的培训信号。 单独的例子需要2.3倍的训练才能与棋道相匹配,不与地形训练相匹配.

blocks.en: Why the continuation helps: a delayed-cue fork. We isolate the role of future supervision with maps containing two equal-length, mirror-image corridors. A single wall k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 } k\in\{1,2,3,5,8,12\} cells down one corridor determines the first move. Every map has a twin with the wall in the other corridor, so ignoring it yields chance accuracy (50%). Four video models train on the same 40,000 maps, steps, and seed. Their targets differ only after the correct first move: no continuation, the next eight route moves, the next three route moves, or seven moves that wander off-route. We score first moves on 320 held-out maps per k k ( Fig. 16 ). With this budget, the first-move-only model responds to walls one and two cells away (99.4 and 92.8%), falls to 57.8% at three cells and is at chance from five cells onward. With the route target, accuracy is 99 to 100% through eight cells and 91.6% at twelve, beyond the drawn continuation. Three route moves help through three cells, while the equally long wandering continuation helps at three but not from five. The gain therefore comes from learning to follow the route toward the decisive wall, rather than clip length alone.
blocks.zh: 为什么续作有帮助:一个被延迟的cue分叉. 我们用包含两个等长的镜像走廊的地图来孤立未来监督的作用. 单壁 k { 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12} k\\ n 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12} 下行一个走廊的单元格决定了第一个动作 。 每张地图都与另一道走廊的墙相通, 4个视频模型列车在同为4万个地图,台阶,和种子上. 其目标仅在正确的先行后不同:无续行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后行后 我们以每千克320个被搁置的地图(图16)取得第一得分。 有了这个预算,只有第一移动模式才能对一和二个细胞的墙壁作出反应(99.4%和92.8%),在三个细胞中下降到57.8%,并且从五个细胞向上走是偶然的. 有了路由目标,精确度通过8个电池为99-100%,12个电池为91.6%,超过所绘制的续作. 3个路由移动帮助通过3个细胞,而同样长的游走延续则帮助了3个,但不是5个. 因此,收益来自学会沿着通往决定性墙的路走,而不是仅仅缩短长度。

blocks.en: More labels or more training? Two controls separate the continuation from what comes with it. First, the continuation supervises eight decisions per map instead of one. A first-move-only model trained on every position along the same eight-move routes as separate examples, with the same 2,500 steps, stays at chance for walls three to eight cells away (53.4%, against 54.2% for the first move only and 99.7% with the continuation). Only one in eight of its examples shows the fork decision, so it is also weaker at near walls (43.1% at two cells). With eight times the steps, when it has seen each fork as often as the first-move model, it reaches 94.2% but remains below the continuation model at distant walls (85.3 against 99.1% at eight cells and 70.0 against 91.6% at twelve). Second, the first-move target can learn the rule, but it needs more training. With twice the steps on the same maps it reaches 84.7% at three to eight cells and 70.9% at twelve, still below the continuation model at every distance, and with eight times the steps it solves every test fork ( Fig. 17 ). The reach of the continuation is also bounded by what is drawn: with the wall 10, 14 and 16 cells away, beyond the eight drawn moves, its accuracy falls to 96, 87 and 71%. This is the pattern expected from intermediate supervision. A target that draws each step toward the cue lets every frame be supervised by evidence next to it, so a long-range dependency is learned as a chain of local ones, which makes composite rules learnable from far fewer examples [ 24 , 6 ] . The continuation thus lowers the amount of training a distant cue requires rather than making learnable what otherwise is not.
blocks.zh: 更多的标签还是更多的训练? 两个控制把续作和随作相分. 第一,继续监督每个地图的八个决定,而不是一个。 一个仅训练在同一条八行走路线上每个位置上的第一行走模式作为单独的例子,有同样的2,500个步骤,在3至8个牢房外的墙壁上留有机会(53.4%,只有54.2%,99.7%与接续)。 它的例子中只有一分之一显示分叉决定,因此在靠近墙壁时也较弱(两细胞为43.1%). 步数为8倍,当它经常看到每个分叉作为第一移动模型时,它达到94.2%,但在远墙上仍然低于延续模型(8个细胞为85.3对99.1%,12个细胞为70.0%对91.6%). 第二,先行目标可以学习规则,但它需要更多的训练. 同一地图上的台阶为两倍,在3至8个细胞上达到84.7%,在12个细胞上达到70.9%,在相距各处仍然低于接续模型,并用8倍的台阶解决了每个测试叉(图17). 续作的伸展范围也以所画出的东西为界:墙外有10,14和16个格,超出所画的8个动作,其精度已降至96%,87%和71%. 这是中间监督所预期的模式。 将每一步骤都引向提示的目标,让每个框架都由旁边的证据监督,因此远程的依赖性被学习成一连串的局部依赖性,这使得复合规则可以从少得多的例子中学习[24,6]. 因此,继续培训会降低远程培训所需的培训量,而不是使那些本来无法学习的东西能够学习。

blocks.en: N-queens: a horizon measured in moves. The delayed-cue fork measures distance to a decisive wall. N-queens lets us measure how many further placements are needed before a wrong first move reaches a dead end. We construct a mirror-balanced test of 3,606 boards on which the next row has exactly two candidate cells: one permits a complete solution, while the other reaches a dead end after further placements. Depths 0, 1 and 2 each have 600 mirror pairs (1,200 boards), while depth 3 has only three pairs and is reported descriptively below. Every board appears with its left–right mirror, so a choice that ignores the future scores 50%. With first-move-only training, accuracy is 71.7, 62.3 and 48.5% at depths 0, 1 and 2 ( Fig. 18 , bottom right). At depth 3 it chooses the completable cell on 4 of 6 boards, too few for a comparable estimate. Taking 20 sampling steps instead of the validation-selected one does not extend the measured horizon (58.5, 53.6 and 46.6% at depths 0 to 2).
blocks.zh: N-queens:以移动测量的地平线. 延后-克克克叉测量距离一堵决定性的墙. N-queens让我们来衡量在错误的第一项行动到达死地之前还需要多少进一步安置。 我们为3 606个板子设计了一个镜像平衡的测试,下一行有整整两个候选细胞:一个允许一个完整的解决方案,而另一个则在进一步安置后到达死胡同。 深度为0,1和2各有600个镜像对(1,200个板子),而深度为3只有3个对子,下面报告为描述. 每个板都用它的左-右镜出现,所以一个忽略未来评分50%的选择. 采用一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相一相 在深度3时,它选择了6个板上4个可填充的单元格,对于可比估计来说太少了. 采用20个取样步骤,而不是选定的验证步骤,不会延长所测的地平线(深度为0至2,58.5、53.6%和46.6%)。

blocks.en: Training on the continuation. In the with continuation condition, the training target draws every missing queen, and in first move only it draws just the next queen. Evaluation reads only the first move in both conditions. With the same training boards, recipe and seed, continuation training raises first-move accuracy to 90.4, 80.2 and 58.7% at dead-end depths 0, 1 and 2 ( Fig. 18 , bottom right). The depth-2 gain is 10.2 points ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). It also improves the first move on held-out solution families (92.6 versus 85.2%) and hard boards (82.0 versus 62.0%). Thus, future supervision helps the image model respond to consequences beyond the next placement, as it helps the video model respond to a distant wall in the fork task.
blocks.zh: 关于继续的培训。 在继续状态下,训练目标会吸引每一个失踪的后人,在第一动作中,只画出下一个后人. 评价只在两种情况下都读出第一个步骤。 通过同样的训练板、食谱和种子,继续训练在0、1和2(图18,右下方)的死底深度将第一行的精度提高到90.4、80.2%和58.7%。 深度-2增收为10.2分(p < 0.001 p < 0.001). 它还改进了被搁置的解决方案家庭(92.6%对85.2%)和硬板(82.0%对62.0%)的第一项行动。 因此,未来的监督有助于图像模型对下个位置之外的后果作出反应,因为它有助于视频模型对叉子任务中的一道远墙作出反应.

blocks.en: Using the drawn solution. We evaluate the model trained with continuation in two ways: draw a complete board once, or execute only its first queen and generate again from the resulting board. On 300 held-out half-filled boards, the closed loop solves 55.7% with two sampling steps per call, against 34.7% for the best one-pass result (20 steps). Across 512 empty-board trials, it solves 38.1% against 17.0% for the best one-pass result (50 steps, Fig. 18 , top right). On the example at left, the first four loop drawings are invalid as complete solutions, yet each supplies a completable next queen. Subsequent drawings become valid and the loop solves the board. The comparison changes how the drawing is used as well as the sampling schedule. It shows that the model’s continuation is more useful when its first decision can be applied and revised than when the entire initial drawing is taken as the answer.
blocks.zh: 使用所绘制的解决方案 。 我们通过两种方式来评价训练的模型:画出一个完整的棋盘一次,或者只执行它的第一后并再次从产生的棋盘中产生. 在300个被搁置的半填充板上,闭合回路以每次呼叫的两个取样步骤解决了55.7%的问题,而最佳单行道成绩(20个步骤)则为34.7%。 在512个空板试验中,它解决了38.1%对17.0%的最佳单行道结果(50步,图18,右上). 在左边的例子上,前四回环画作为完整的解决方案是无效的,然而每个回环都提供了可完成的下个后王后. 随后的绘图变得有效,循环解决了棋盘. 比较改变了图纸的使用方式和取样时间表。 它表明,当第一个决定可以适用和修订时,该模型的延续比整个初步图纸作为答案时更有用.

blocks.en: Changing the board. In a separate intervention, the environment adds a queen after the first move that contradicts the model’s initially drawn solution. At two steps per call, a plan-breaking change is possible on 145 of the 300 half-filled boards. The loop solves 55.2% of these changed episodes, against 48.3% on the same boards without a change. A control adds the queen where the model had planned it. The plan-breaking condition outperforms this control on half-filled boards at two steps (55.2 versus 42.1%, p = 0.011 p=0.011 ), but underperforms it from empty boards (43.2 versus 51.9%, p = 0.0007 p=0.0007 ). At 20 steps, the control comparisons are 46.3 versus 43.4% on half-filled boards and 43.5 versus 40.8% from empty boards, and neither difference is significant. Against no change, the plan-breaking condition is no worse numerically in the same four settings (55.2 versus 48.3, 43.2 versus 38.5, 46.3 versus 44.1, and 43.5 versus 40.8%). These results show that the loop can continue from an unexpected state without an observed average penalty, but not that breaking its plan helps.
blocks.zh: 换板子 在一次单独的干预中,环境在与模型最初绘制的解决方案相矛盾的第一个动作后会再增加一个后座. 在每通电话的两个步骤中,可以对300个半满板中的145个板块进行突破性改变。 循环解决了55.2%的这些已改变的相片,而同一相片上48.3%的相片没有变化. 一个控制器增加了模特儿计划好的后座. 计划突破条件在两步(55.2–42.1%,p = 0.011–0.011 ) 上超过了半填板的这种控制,但从空板(43.2%–51.9%,p = 0.07–0.07 ) 上表现不佳。 在20步中,半填板的控制对比为46.3%–43.4%,从空板43.5%–40.8%,两者差别都不大。 在没有变化的情况下,在同样四种情况下(55.2对48.3、43.2对38.5、46.3对44.1和43.5%对40.8%),计划中断的情况在数字上没有恶化。 这些结果显示,循环可以从一个意外状态继续,而没有观察到的平均惩罚,但不能说明破坏其计划有帮助.

blocks.en: The continuation is not read at inference. If the model consulted its generated continuation to choose the first move, changing that continuation should change the decision. During video generation, we fix the opponent-reply frames to show either the engine’s refutation of the model’s first move or a weak reply, while keeping that first move visible. Under either condition, the first move changes on only 0.8% of 1,000 validation puzzles (exact McNemar p = 1 p=1 ). Together with the fork experiment, this points to a training benefit: predicting future states shapes the learned decision, but the drawn continuation is not consulted to make it.
blocks.zh: 续作不以推论相取. 如果该模式参考其生成的续作选择第一个步骤,改变这一续作应改变决定。 在视频生成过程中,我们固定了对手的复制帧,以显示引擎对模型第一次动作的反驳或者弱回音,同时保持第一次动作的可见性. 在任一条件下,第一个移动仅会改变1000个验证谜题中的0.8%(精确 McNemar p = 1 p = 1). 与分叉实验一起,这说明培训的好处:预测未来状态会塑造所学的决定,但所绘制的续作没有被咨询来完成.

blocks.en: A parallel in language models. Language models show a related effect under the name of multi-token prediction. Training a model to predict several future tokens at each position, instead of only the next one, improves sample efficiency, with the extra predictions serving as an auxiliary training task [ 6 ] . The authors suggest that the gain comes from choice points, the positions whose outcome shapes what follows, which receive a stronger training signal when the future is predicted as well. A next best move is such a point. Our results show the same principle in a visual generator, where the predicted future consists of drawn states and opponent replies instead of tokens, and they allow two further tests: the drawn future can be changed at inference without changing the decision, and the same decisions given as separate examples do not replace it at the same compute.
blocks.zh: 语言模型的平行. 语言模型以多键预测为名显示相干效应. 训练一个模型,以预测每个位置的数个未来符号,而不是仅仅下一个符号,提高样本效率,额外预测作为辅助训练任务[6]. 作者认为,收益来自选择点,这些职位的结果决定了随后的情况,在预测未来时,这些职位会得到更强有力的培训信号。 下一个最好步骤就是这一点。 我们的结果在视觉生成器中显示了同样的原理,其中预测的未来由所绘制的状态和对手的回答而不是符号组成,它们允许另外两个测试:所绘制的未来可以在推论中被改变而不改变决定,作为单独实例给出的相同决定不会在同一计算中被替换.

blocks.en: Executing the drawn moves. In deterministic tasks, a predicted clip can be executed in full. On terrain maps, whole-clip execution finds a cheapest route on 82.8% of test maps, compared with 83.0% when predicting again after every move, and the probe-set rates are 76.8 and 78.8%. On uniform maps, clips solve 94.6% of test maps, versus 96.0% for a receding horizon on the first 500. Each clip executes up to eight moves per call, rather than one, yielding 3.6 versus 19.4 seconds per executed move ( Tab. 21 ). Against an opponent, predicted replies may differ from actual ones. On the 1,411 chess puzzles where the video model correctly drew its first move and the opponent’s reply and went on to draw a next move, that move is correct 41.2% of the time, while a fresh prediction on the observed board after those same moves reaches 52.5%. Table 15 gives 39.5% for the drawn move because it also counts the 62 clips that stop after the reply. Against the exact Connect Four solver, receding-horizon play converts 28.7% of won starts, compared with 22.7% when drawn moves are played regardless of the opponent’s replies ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 , 150 games).
blocks.zh: 执行所绘制的动作 。 在决定性的任务中,可以完全执行一个预测的剪辑. 在地形图上,全克立普执行在82.8%的测试地图上找到了一条最便宜的路线,而每次移动后再次预测时的这个比例为83.0%,而探测器设定的比率为76.8%和78.8%. 在统一的地图上,剪辑解析了94.6%的测试地图,而前500年的平面缩小则解析了96.0%。 每个片段每个调用最多执行8个动作,而不是1个,每个执行的动作产生3.6秒比19.4秒(Tab. 21. 针对对手,预测的答复可能不同于实际的答复。 在1,411个棋盘上,视频模型正确绘制出第一个动作和对手的回击,接着绘制出下一个动作,这一动作是41.2%的正确时间,而同样动作之后观察到的棋盘上的新预测达到52.5%。 表15给出了39.5%的抽取量,因为它也计算了答复后停止的62个片段。 相对于精确的Connect Four 解析器,回旋-视距游戏转换了28.7%的取胜开始,而无论对手的答复(p = 0.004 p = 0.004, 150 个游戏),抽出动作时则转换出22.7%。

blocks.en: We trained the chess models on increasing amounts of data with otherwise identical recipes, and evaluated each on validation puzzles with three sampling seeds ( Tab. 17 ). Accuracy rises steadily for every model, and the gains do not slow down at the largest size, which suggests that data, not model capacity, limits these results. With the prompt mixture of Appendix M , the image model’s error rate falls roughly as a power law in the number of examples, with exponents of about 0.17 (unguided) and 0.21 (guided). The video model follows a similar curve (0.15). Each fit uses only three points, so the exponents are rough estimates. With the best-move prompt alone, tripling the data to three million puzzles raises validation accuracy from 39.7 to 56.7%.
blocks.zh: 我们培训了国际象棋模型,以增加数据数量,并用本来相同的食谱,用三个取样种子(Tab. 17)在验证谜题上评价了每一个。 每个模型的准确度稳步上升,收益不会在最大规模上放缓,这表明数据而不是模型容量限制了这些结果. 随着附录M的迅速混合,图像模型的出错率在实例数量中大致下降到了权力定律,其出错率约为0.17(无指向)和0.21(有指向). 视频模型采用相类似的曲线(0.15). 每个相配体只使用三分,所以形容体是粗略的估计. 光是移动最迅速,数据就增至三百万个谜题,使验证精度从39.7%提高到56.7%。

blocks.en: Two effects grow with data. First, contrastive guidance helps more as the model improves: its gain over unguided sampling is 4.4 points at 160k examples, 5.3 at 400k and 9.0 at 1M. Second, the advantage of imagining the full line over drawing a single decision grows from 2.3 to 3.2 and 8.0 test points at 80k, 400k and one million videos ( Appendix K ). Go shows the same trend: the model trained on one million positions matches KataGo’s move on 20.9% of test positions, against 11.3% when trained on 100,000 ( p < 10 − 20 p<10^{-20} ), and 27.9% with majority voting.

blocks.en: Results. Contrastive guidance improves the mixture-trained model, although the main results use unguided models. At one million chess puzzles, guidance raises single-sample accuracy from 31.8 to 40.9% ( Tab. 9 ). Much of this gain offsets the prompt mixture: training on the best-move prompt alone reaches 39.9% without guidance, and training on three times as much data reaches 56.0% ( Tab. 1 ). Voting narrows the guidance gain from 9.1 to 3.6 points with eight samples (40.0 versus 43.6%). Go shows a similar pattern at 100,000 positions: guidance raises single-sample accuracy from 9.3 to 14.0%, versus 11.3% for best-move-only training. With eight votes, the variants reach 14.1, 17.4, and 17.8%. We therefore treat guidance as optional rather than using it in the main tables. Its advantage over unguided sampling grows with training data ( Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 结果。 对照制导改进了受混合物训练的模型,虽然主要结果使用无制导模型. 在一百万个国际象棋谜题上,指导将单样精度从31.8%提高到40.9%(图9.). 大部分收益抵消了迅速的混合:在未获得指导的情况下,仅关于最佳移动快件的培训就达到39.9%,关于数据三倍的培训达到56.0%(附件1)。 投票将指导收益从9.1分缩小至3.6分,有8个样本(40.0%对43.6%)。 Go在100,000个位置上显示了类似模式:指导将单样精度从9.3%提高到14.0%,而仅限移动的训练则为11.3%。 以8票的得票率,变体达到14.1,17.4%和17.8%. 因此,我们将指导视为可选的,而不是在主要表格中使用。 其相对于无指导取样的优势随着培训数据而增加(附录L)。

blocks.en: Qwen-Image uses Qwen3-VL to encode the prompt and input image, raising the possibility that the vision-language model solves the task while diffusion merely renders its answer. We test this on terrain pathfinding, where tile costs are hidden and must be inferred from examples. These image models draw an entire route in one image, unlike the closed-loop model of Tab. 2 , which reaches the same 87.5% on the test maps but 85.0% on the probe maps. All variants use the same data, training steps, and learning rate.
blocks.zh: Quen-Image使用Quen3-VL来编码即时和输入图像,提高了视觉-语言模型解决任务而扩散仅能使答案的可能性. 我们在寻找地形路径时检验这一点,其中砖块成本是隐藏的,必须从实例中推断出。 这些图像模型在一个图像中绘制出整个路线,与Tab的闭路模型不同. 2,在测试地图上达到87.5%,而探测地图上达到85.0%. 所有变体都使用相同的数据,培训步骤和学习率.

blocks.zh: 表18:使用不同主干线和文本编码器的Terrain路径调查(占测试和探测地图的百分比). 图像模型在一幅图像中绘制出完整的路线,视频模型绘制并执行了可长达8个动作的剪辑.

blocks.en: We first prevent Qwen-Image’s text encoder from seeing the image, leaving the diffusion transformer as the sole visual input path. Cheapest-route accuracy remains 88.1 versus 87.5% (exact McNemar p = 0.59 p=0.59 ). On probe maps it falls by 5.0 points, from 87.6 to 82.6% ( p = 0.008 p=0.008 ), so the encoder helps on difficult choices but is not necessary to infer the hidden costs: the blind model remains well above chance. We next use FLUX.2 [klein], a smaller 4B backbone with a text-only encoder. Its 86.1 and 83.8% are not significantly different from Qwen-Image ( p = 0.29 p=0.29 and 0.07 0.07 ), and every model exceeds the terrain-blind planner ( Tab. 18 ). The video model provides a third test because its text encoder is also text-only. On the same million chess puzzles, it reaches 41.7 versus 39.9% for Qwen-Image on 10,000 test puzzles ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ). The latter reaches 40.9% with contrastive guidance ( p = 0.16 p=0.16 ). Together, these results indicate that the visual decision capability is not confined to Qwen-Image or to an encoder that sees the image.
blocks.zh: 我们首先防止Quen-Image的文本编码器看到图像,将扩散变压器作为唯一的视觉输入路径. 最便宜的路线精度仍为88.1%,而为87.5%(精确的McNemar p=0.59 p=0.59)。 在探测地图上,它下降5.0分,从87.6%到82.6%(p = 0.008 p = 0.008),因此编码器帮助了困难的选择,但没有必要推断出所隐藏的成本:盲模型仍然远远高于机会. 我们接下来使用FLUX.2[klein],一个更小的4B主干,只有文本编码器. 它的86.1%和83.8%与"Quen-Image"(p=0.29 p=0.29和0.07 0.07)没有显著区别,每个型号都超过了"地形盲"(Tab. 视频模型提供了第三次测试,因为它的文本编码器也是只使用文本. 在同一百万个国际象棋谜题上,在一万个测试谜题(p = 0.001 p = 0.001)上,Quen-Image的比分达到41.7比 39.9%,后者在对比性引导下达到40.9% (p = 0.16 p = 0.16). 这些结果表明,视觉决定能力并不局限于Quen-Image或能看见图像的编码器.

blocks.en: We compare models that predict moves directly from rendered images, or from text descriptions of the same positions for language models. They use the same puzzles or maps and validation sets, and are scored with the same rule-free readout: illegal answers count as wrong ( Tab. 19 ). Strong symbolic chess transformers [ 18 ] use board encodings and chess-specific move vocabularies, so they are not directly applicable to the other tasks.

blocks.en: Vision-language models. Without fine-tuning, Qwen3-VL (8B and 32B) performs worse than a random legal move, whether given a board image or FEN text. Fine-tuned on the same one million puzzles to answer in UCI notation, the 8B model reaches 42.0%, significantly below our one-step video model’s 50.5% ( Tab. 19 ). The gap widens on tests that distinguish recall from play ( Tab. 9 ). Far from training, accuracy is 34.1 versus 45.0%. Mirroring costs − 5.5 -5.5 versus − 1.0 -1.0 points, and when one changed piece makes another move best, the model retains its old move in 61.1 versus 48.1% of cases. These tests suggest that the visual generative model responds more reliably to task-relevant changes in the board than the vision-language model.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型. 不进行微调,Qune3-VL(8B和32B)的性能比任意合法动作更差,无论是给与棋盘图像还是FEN文本. 8B模型达到了42.0%, 差距在与游戏区分开的测试上有所扩大(附件9)。 准确率远非训练,而是34.1%对45.0%。 镜像成本为- 5.5 - 5.5相比为- 1.0 - 1.0分,当一个改变的片段让另一个动作最好时,模型在61.1%的个案中保留了旧动作. 这些测试表明,视觉基因模型比视觉语言模型更可靠地回应了板上与任务相关的变化.

blocks.en: A text-only language model. We fine-tune the similarly sized Qwen3-8B on the same one million puzzles and with the same recipe as the vision-language model. It reads FEN and answers in UCI notation, using greedy decoding without reasoning before the answer. Its 40.9% accuracy is significantly below the one-step video model (exact McNemar p < 10 − 60 p<10^{-60} ). The gap widens far from training (32.7 versus 45.0%), mirroring costs − 7.1 -7.1 points, and on changed boards it keeps the old move in 65.6% of cases where another move is best. With three million puzzles, it reaches 52.0%, versus 62.5% for the one-step image model on the same data. The two language models achieve similar accuracy and show similar failure patterns whether the input is an image or text. Compared with answering in text, drawing the move on the board yields higher accuracy with matched data, especially where the correct action depends on the current position rather than a familiar pattern.
blocks.zh: 唯文本语言模型. 我们用与视觉语言模型相同的配方,在100万个谜题上微调了类似大小的Qwen3-8B. 它在UCI注解中读取了FEN和答案,在回答之前使用没有推理的贪婪解码. 其40.9%的精度明显低于一步视频模型(精确的McNemar p < 10-60 p < 10-60}). 差距远远超出培训(32.7%对45.0%),反射成本为7.1至7.1分,在改变后的板上,65.6%的板上保持了旧的移动方式,而其他移动方式最好。 拥有300万个谜题,达到52.0%,而同一数据上的单步图像模型则为62.5%. 两种语言模型都取得了相近的准确性并显示了相近的失败模式,无论输入是图像还是文本. 与文本中的回答相比,在棋盘上绘制动作会以相匹配的数据产生更高的准确度,特别是在正确的动作取决于当前位置而不是熟悉的模式的情况下.

blocks.en: The output decides. A generic transformer on frozen DINOv2-L features reaches 50.0% after eight passes with a 4,096-way move output, or 48.1% when the board is misaligned with its patches. Changing only the output to score moves at their origin and destination squares raises accuracy to 78.5%, nearly identical to a head given the full board structure (78.6%). The spatial output thus accounts for much of the classifier’s strength. Drawing provides a spatial output across tasks without designing a separate head for each. After the same one pass and batch 8 used for our image model, the generic classifier reaches 21.8%, versus 45.5% for our model.
blocks.zh: 产出决定. 被冻结的DINOv2-L特性上的通用变压器在有4,096个行走输出的8个通过后达到50.0%,当板与它的补丁错接时达到48.1%. 仅将输出改变为在原产地和目的地平方的分数移动,精度提高到78.5%,与一个头几乎相同,因为有完整的棋盘结构(78.6%). 因此,空间输出占分类者强度的大部分。 绘图提供了跨任务的空间输出,但没有为每个任务设计一个单独的头. 在我们的图像模型中使用的同一通关和第八批之后,通用分级器达到了21.8%,而我们的模型则为45.5%。

blocks.en: Learning from each example. With training to convergence, classifiers solve the delayed-cue fork (100%) and produce optimal routes more often than our whole-route model. After one pass over the fork maps, matching our models’ exposure, they respond to the wall only when it is one or two cells away (67.2%, or 58.7% with route supervision). Our route-drawing model reaches 98.4%.
blocks.zh: 从每一个例子中学习。 随着集成培训,分类器解决了延迟-cue分叉(100%),并比我们全程模式更频繁地产生出最佳路线. 在经过一圈叉地图之后, 与我们的模型的曝光量相匹配, 只有当墙被隔出一两个细胞(67.2%, 我们的路线绘制模型达到98.4%.

blocks.en: Transfer to a new layout. We also test forks whose corridors meet at a right angle, a layout absent from training. The converged classifiers reach 58.0 and 49.5% and often move into a wall by choosing the direction favoured in the training layout. Our model retains 94.0%. This suggests that the classifiers learned a layout-specific shortcut, whereas the route-drawing model transfers to the new geometry.
blocks.zh: 转入新布局 。 我们还测试其走廊以正确角度相会的叉子,一个没有训练的布局. 相接的分类器达到58.0%和49.5%,经常通过选择训练布局中偏好的方向而移动入墙. 我们的型号保留94.0%. 这表明分级者学到了一种特定布局的快捷方式,而路由绘图模型则转移到了新的几何.

blocks.en: Table 20 : One model for two tasks (%). One image model is trained on Connect Four and terrain together, starting from the pretrained model. Single-task models use the same examples and training recipe. Baselines are the one-move heuristic for Connect Four, a terrain-blind planner for pathfinding, and chance for the detour-or-cross probe.
blocks.zh: 表20:两个任务的一个模式(%)。 一个图像模型在"连接四"和"地形"一起接受训练,从预先训练的模型开始. 单一任务模型使用相同的实例和培训配方. 基线是"连接四号"的一模一样的热度,是寻找路径的地盲规划器,也是绕道或交叉探测的机会.

blocks.en: One model for two tasks. We jointly train one image model on Connect Four and terrain pathfinding, using the same prompt for both tasks. The model must identify the task from its input image, and each task contributes the same number of examples and uses the same recipe as its single-task counterpart ( Tab. 20 ). Joint training preserves Connect Four performance and the ability to decide whether to cross costly terrain, and stays within a few points of the single-task model on the cheapest route. Thus, one visual generator can support more than one task.
blocks.zh: 两个任务的一个模型。 我们联合在"连接四"和"地形路径调查"上训练出一个图像模型,同时使用同样的快取来完成这两个任务. 模型必须从其输入图像中识别任务,每个任务提供相同数量的例子,并使用与其单任务对应方(Tab. 20)相同的配方. 联合训练保留了"连通四"的性能和决定是否穿越昂贵地形的能力,并停留在最廉价路线上单任务模式的几个点内. 因此,一个视觉生成器可以支持一个以上的任务.

blocks.en: Appendix P Legality of the drawn actions
blocks.zh: 附 录 二 已撤销诉讼的合法性

blocks.en: Because no model receives the rules, its raw drawing may be illegal, and all reported results count such actions as failures. Measured directly on the test sets, almost all raw drawings are legal. In chess, the image model trained on three million puzzles draws a legal move on 97.0% of positions (88.3 to 88.7% at one million puzzles), and the video model trained on one million on 93.4%. After legal drawn moves, 97.3% of imagined video boards are correct on all 64 squares, with 99.95% of individual squares correct. In Go, the marked point is legal 99.8% of the time, versus 43% for the base model. Connect Four discs occupy a non-full column and the correct landing row in 100.0% of image outputs and 99.6% of video outputs, although gravity is never stated. For the image and video models respectively, routes are valid on 94.7 and 97.4% of shortest-path maps and on 98.5 and 95.0% of terrain maps, and 99.2 and 98.2% of billiards outputs are readable shots.
blocks.zh: 由于没有任何模型收到规则,其原始图纸可能是非法的,所有报告的结果都把这样的行动算作失败. 直接在测试集上测量,几乎所有生平图纸都是合法的. 在围棋中,接受过300万个谜题训练的图像模型从97.0%的位置上(88.3%到88.7%在100万个谜题上),视频模型在93.4%上接受过100万次训练. 经过合法抽取动作后,所有64个平面上97.3%的想象中视频板正确,99.95%的个人平面正确. 在"去"中,标点为合法时间的99.8%,而基模为43%. 连接四盘占据了非全列和正确的起落行,分别占图像输出的100.0%和视频输出的99.6%,尽管从未说明重力. 就图像和视频模型而言,路线在94.7%和97.4%的最短路径地图和98.5%和95.0%的地形图上有效,99.2%和98.2%的台球产出是可读镜头。

blocks.en: Training uses nodes with eight NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs (24 GB each). The image model and its text encoder do not fit together on one GPU, so each process uses two: one holds the diffusion transformer, the other Qwen3-VL and the VAE. At 256 256 pixels and two examples per process, peak memory is 18.3 GB on the transformer’s GPU and 18.5 GB on the encoder’s. The video model fits on one GPU, peaking between 15 and 18 GB depending on resolution. Table 21 reports training costs for the main runs.
blocks.zh: 训练使用有8个NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU的节点(每个节点24GB). 图像模型及其文本编码器在一个GPU上不相容,因此每个过程都使用两个:一个持有扩散变压器,另一个是Qune3-VL和VAE. 每个过程256个像素和两个例子,峰值内存为变压器的GPU上18.3GB和编码器上18.5GB. 视频模型适合一个GPU,视分辨率而定,在15到18GB之间达到峰值. 表21报告了主要业务的培训费用。

blocks.en: Inference cost depends chiefly on the number of denoising steps and on whether guidance adds a second forward pass ( Tab. 21 ). One-step sampling ( Appendix C ) is the cheapest setting and, without guidance, also the more accurate one. Voting multiplies the cost by the number of samples. The execution protocol matters on move-by-move tasks: a video clip executes up to eight moves per call and solves a terrain map in about the time of the image model’s closed loop, while the receding horizon generates a new clip for every executed move and is about five times slower.
blocks.zh: 推论费用主要取决于取消提名的步骤的数目以及指导是否增加了第二个前行通行证(表21)。 单步取样(附录C)是最便宜的设定,没有指导,也更准确. 投票将成本乘以样本数量。 执行协议对移动任务很重要:视频剪辑每个调用最多执行8个动作,并在图像模型闭环的大约时间解开地形图,而折叠的地平线则为每一个被执行的动作产生出新的剪辑并慢了约5倍.
